3.3 文字作文第一段：文字改写+表明态度
大多数同学对图画作文、图表作文非常熟悉，却没有见过文字作文，文字
作文进入大纲后还未考过，因此我们只能看大纲样题。
52. Directions:
Read the following excerpt from an article and write an essay. In your essay,
you should explain whether or to what extent you agree with the author. Support
your argument with reasons and relevant examples.
Write your answer in 160-200words on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)
“阅读下面的节选并写一篇文章。在你的文章中，你应该说明自己是否或
在多大程度上同意作者的观点。用理由和相关的例子来支持你的论点。”
从题干我们可以得知文字作文的要求有两点：1.表明态度；2.论证观点。这
两点并不足以支撑起整篇文章，因此文字作文的三段话我们这样安排：第一段
文字改写+表明态度；第二段原因分析；第三段总结全文+具体措施+畅想未来。
可以看出，文字作文与图画图表作文只是第一段不同，二三两段相同。此时，
请再次回味前文所说的：图画作文是透过图画看寓意、图表作文是透过图表看
现象、文字作文是阅读文字提主题，他们的本质都是议论文。
Many of us, whatever our field of work, fear that showing uncertainty can
damage our image - and we may compensate by expressing overconfidence in an
attempt to win trust. But in many situations people are willing to trust those who can
admit they don't have a definitive answer. Recent studies found that communicating
uncertainty and even admitting our mistakes is not harmful and can even be
beneficial to trustworthiness. So, failure in “ expertise" can be compensated by
higher integrity and benevolence. When communicating uncertainty in a transparent
way, we are perceived as less biased and willing to tell the truth.
我们中的许多人，无论身处什么工作领域，都害怕表现出会损害我们的形
象的不确定性——我们可能会通过表现出过度自信去弥补，尝试赢得信任。但
在许多情况下，人们愿意信任那些承认自己没有明确答案的人。最近研究发现，
交流不确定性甚至承认错误是没有危害的，甚至能助于提升可信度。所以，在
36
“专业”上的失败可以用高度的诚信和仁慈来补偿。当以一种透明的方式交流
不确定性时，我们会被认为不那么有偏见并且愿意说出真相。
1 ：文字改写
从大纲样题我们可以看出，这段话可以分为两个部分：描述现象+表达观点。
两个部分的分界线是“研究表明(Recent studies found that)”，之前是作者描述
的现象，之后是研究表明的观点，也就是作者的观点。因此，我们的“文字改
写”也要分为两部分：改写现象+改写观点。改写思路有同义词/词组替换、主
动变被动、被动变主动、高度概括、变换修饰语位置等。
改写现象：Nowadays, gaining trust from others is vital in the workplace. Many
people are afraid of damaging their image by appearing unsure.
如今，在职场中获得他人的信任是至关重要的。许多人害怕表现得不自信会损
害自己的形象。
改写观点：While the author believes that we are perceived as less biased and willing
to tell the truth when we show uncertainty in a transparent way.
而作者认为，当我们以一种透明的方式表达不确定性时，我们会被认为不那么
有偏见，愿意说出真相。
不会改写怎么办？引出主题+复述观点
建议大家首选改写，如果实在是改写不出来，可以选择如下句子。
引出主题：
待选1：It cannot be denied that 主题词plays a key role in people’s work and life.
不能被否认地是XXX 在人们工作和生活中扮演了重要角色。
待选2：It is widely accepted that 主题词, a strong and positive life attitude, is the
key element for individuals to achieve success.
人们普遍认为XXX，一个坚强和积极生活态度，是个人取得成功的关键因素。
待选3：Nowadays, it is well-known that the problem/ phenomenon of 主题词has
caused wide concern.
待选4：Due to the progress of society and the improvement of technology,主题词
has become a common phenomenon/ problem in our daily life.
37
由于社会的进步和技术的进步，XXX 已经成为我们日常生活中一个普遍的现象/
问题。
待选5：Currently, whether to 选择1 or 选择2 has become a hot topic among
people, especially among the young, and heated discussions are right on their way.
目前，是XXX 还是XXX 已经成为人们的热门话题，尤其是在年轻人中，激烈的
讨论即将到来。
改写观点：
待选1：While the author believes that+文字中作者的观点
待选2：Therefore, the author holds that+文字中作者的观点
待选3：According to the author's perspective, +文字中作者的观点
待选4：In the opinion of the author, +文字中作者的观点
注：题干中要求“说明自己是否或在多大程度上同意作者的观点”，所以必须
表明作者的观点。作者观点虽然有两三句，但它们是“同义句”，大家选择容
易改写的句子改写即可。
2 ：表明态度
这句话特别简单，就是“说明自己是否或在多大程度上同意作者的观点”。无
非是以下三种情况：
I agree with the author’s point of view.同意
I don’t agree with the author’s opinion.不同意
I agree with the author’s point of view to some extent. 在一定程度上同意
注：这句话虽然短，但必须有，因为题干有明确要求。
至此，文字作文第一段讲解完毕，以样题为例，使用不会改写的写法，完整的
第一段为：It cannot be denied that integrity and benevolence play a key role in
people’s work and life. The author believes that we are perceived as less biased and
willing to tell the truth when we show uncertainty in a transparent way. I agree with
the author’s point of view.
不可否认，诚信和仁慈在人们的工作和生活中起着关键作用。作者认为，当我
们以透明的方式展示不确定性时，我们会被认为偏见更少，更愿意说实话。我
同意作者的观点。
38
以另外一道大纲样题为例：
Studies in the U.S. and the U.K. consistently show that children have lost the
right to wander. This is why many of our youth turn to technology. They aren't
addicted to the computer; they're addicted to interaction, and being around their
friends. Children, and especially teenagers, don't want to only socialize with parents
and siblings; they want to play with their peers. That's how they make sense of the
world. And we've robbed them of that opportunity. We're raising our children in
captivity and they turn to technology to socialize, learn and relax. Why are we
blaming the screens?
美国和英国的研究一致表明，儿童已经失去了漫游的权利。这就是为什么
我们的许多年轻人转向科技。他们不会对电脑上瘾；他们沉迷于互动，和朋友
在一起。孩子们，尤其是青少年，不想只和父母和兄弟姐妹交往；他们想和同
龄人一起玩。这就是他们感知世界的方式。而我们却剥夺了他们的机会。我们
在囚禁中抚养我们的孩子，他们寻求科技来社交、学习和放松。我们为什么要
责怪屏幕呢？
使用不会改写的写法，完整的第一段为：Due to the progress of society and the
improvement of technology, network addiction among children has become a
common phenomenon in our daily life. While the author believes that we can not
blame the screens because children have lost the right to make sense of the world. I
agree with the author’s point of view.
由于社会的进步和科技的进步，儿童网络成瘾已经成为我们日常生活中的
一个普遍现象。然而作者认为，我们不能责怪屏幕，因为孩子们已经失去了理
解世界的权利。我同意作者的观点。
注：很明显，上一道样题我们必须同意作者的观点，这道样题我们同意、不同
意、部分同意均可。
至此，文字作文第一段讲解完毕，第二、三段和图画图表作文相同。样题
1 主题：围绕诚实、诚信、坦诚的重要性；样题2：科技的利与弊。

3.4 通用的第二段：原因分析
图画、图表、文字作文的本质都是议论文，因此第二段围绕某事为什么很
重要、某事给我们带来的好处（或坏处）、某现象为什么发生、某现象意味着
什么来写，这就是原因分析。
③：过渡句，引出原因分析
升级前：There are many reasons to explain my idea.
many
innumerable/ countless/ abundant/ adequate/ sufficient/ a host of/
a variety of/ plenty of
reason
factor/ element/ cause
explain
contribute/ give rise to/ account for
idea
standpoint/ outlook/ perspective/ viewpoint/ opinion
There exist plenty of causes accounting for my opinions in various aspects.
这里有很多原因可以从不同的角度解释我的观点。
Three key reasons, in my humble opinion, could account for this standpoint.
在我看来，这里有三条原因可以解释这个观点。
In my perspective, the causes/ advantages/ disadvantages of ... mainly lie in three
aspects.在我看来，主题词的诱因/优势/劣势主要是以下三个方面。
Several factors contribute to my viewpoint.
一些因素促成了我的观点。
A variety of reasons can be cited to account for this phenomenon.
有很多原因可以用来解释这一现象。
Many factors contribute to the tendency reflected in this chart.
许多因素促成了这张图表所反映的趋势。
注1：受限于文章的字数要求，英语一写3 点原因，英语二写2~3 点原因。
注2：上述待选句中的观点（opinion）和现象（phenomenon）可互换。
④句：原因一
⑤句：原因二
⑥句：原因三
这三句均为原因句，因此合并讲解，给大家提供多个方案，自行挑选、排
序，形成三点原因。这样每位同学都独一无二了~
大家要注意结构清晰，三个原因可保持并列关系，从不同的角度论证自己
的观点；或递进关系，逐层深入的剖析论点。当然，在考场上可能顾不上什么
内在逻辑关系，那么就请使用一组连接词，至少看起来文章结构一下子就变得
清晰明了。
连接词
Firstly,... Secondly,...Thirdly
To begin with,...What’s more,...Last but not least
Above all,...Furthermore,...In the end
Primarily,... Subsequently,... As a final point,...​
Most importantly,... Equally importantly,... Most crucially,...​
方案一：举例论证
很多作文书和课提供名人的例子供你使用，比如马云、奥巴马、爱迪生等，
但用处不大，因为这些例子局限于一个方面，用上的概率实在是太小，背下来
的性价比不高。建议大家灵活应变举身边的例子，放弃背诵名人事例，专注于
准备2~3 个来自于生活、经历、社会的例子。例如：一位上瘾的室友、一个社
区的改变等。下面直接以真题为例进行讲解。

方案二：宾语从句+定语从句
公式：
The majority of people believe that 主题词will provide them with a broader
platform to 主题词带来的好处(do Sth.), which may put them in a beneficial
position in the future.
注1：believe 可被替换为maintain 坚持认为、hold the view 持有观点；
注2：provide them with a broader platform 可被替换为present them with a unique
chance/ create more opportunities for them
注3：which may put them in a beneficial position in the future.可被替换为which is
likely to secure a competitive edge in the future.

注2：24 年英一大作文考图画+图表组合，25 年英一大作文考了图表，而且是
纯表格，打破历史惯例，英一似乎完成了从考图画到考图表的过渡。但根据大
纲来看，英一英二大作文依然都有可能考到图画、图表、文字作文！必须全面
准备，防止再次被命题人反押题。那么图画作文和图表作文在主题词上最大的
不同是什么呢？抽象和具体。图画作文主题词抽象，多为精神、品质，不会拼
写时很容易想到近义词；图表作文主题词具体，多为物品、方式、选项，不会
拼就是不会拼。所以去年，很多英一同学折在了空调、洗衣机、冰箱上。这提
示我们：基础、日常、生活词汇同样需要会拼写。

方案三：主语从句、宾语从句、同位语从句
主语从句在复合句中充当主语，为防句子头重脚轻，通常把形式主语it 放
在句首，真正主语放在句末；宾语从句在复合句中充当宾语，位于及物动词、
介词或复合谓语之后。同位语从句在复合句中充当同位语，用来对其前面的抽
象名词进行解释说明。看不懂就不用管了，直接背。
主语从句
It is well/ commonly/ universally known that…
众所周知的是
It has been widely accepted/ proved/ suggested/ reported that…
已被广泛接受/证明/建议/报道的是
It has become increasingly evident that...
日益显著的是
宾语从句
There is no doubt that.../Nobody can deny that…
毫无疑问的是
An increasing number of people are beginning to realize/ aware that…
越来越多的人开始意识到
We must acknowledge the fact that...
我们必须承认的是
同位语从句
Definitely no one can deny such an obvious fact that…
当然没人能否认这样一个明显的事实
A rising number of individuals are coming to the realization that…
We are faced with the undeniable fact that...
我们面临着一个不可否认的事实
以上从句作用是拉长句子，没有必要学习三者的语法，记住以上待选句即可。
本方案的重点和难点并非这半句话，而是省略号后面怎么去写——善用短语。

以09、15 年英一网络为例：
Definitely no one can deny such an obvious fact that the popularity of the Internet
plays a crucial role in effective communication and information collection among
various areas.
没有人可以否认这样一个事实，互联网的流行在很多领域都扮演了有效交流和
获取信息的重要角色。
49

联网的流行。注意谓语的单复数！
It has been widely accepted that fitness has a beneficial influence on physical and
mental health.
人们普遍认为健身对身心健康都有好处。

注1：加粗部分是主题词和某方面，未加粗部分万年不变。主题词很好写（其
实就是市面上老师总结的“X 大热门话题”之类的），关键问题在于某方面怎
么写。下面提供“五大方面”，一定能用得上。
五大方面

交流方面

至此，本方案讲解结束。以上五大方面并不是要你全部背诵！很显然，上
边的词组你都认识，但很少在作文中用到。这是意识问题，该如何培养呢？请
重新快速过一遍上方的词组，有没有发现一些万能的词组？
只要一件事是有利的，那么这件事在大的方面来看，就会促进社会进步、
发展；在小的方面来看，就会提高生活质量、丰富精神生活、开拓眼界等。因
此我认为：“社会方面”和“个人方面”的词组是一定用的到的。
由此看来，我们需要培养这样的意识——不要写你想写的，应该写你会写
的，把你的写作方向和写作内容尽量向你的语料库去靠。有同学问：“会不会
很生硬啊？”答：“一般情况下不会，但也有比较难套的，这时候语料库丰富
的同学就占便宜了。但我认为，言之有理即可，只要两者之间有联系，就没问
题。”
54
再分享一点点自己的思考，梳理逻辑，方便记忆，快速选择。历年作文主
题无非是人与自我、人与他人、人与社会、人与自然的结合，在写第二段原因
分析的时候可以如此提示自己：
2010 年文化火锅——
人与自我（继承发扬）+人与他人（文化交流）+人与社会（全球化）
2025 年英一居民耐用消费品拥有量——
人与自我（生活幸福）+人与社会（经济发展）
2025 年英二老年人主要日常休闲活动调查——
人与自我（生活幸福）+人与社会（公共福利）
方案四：not only…but also…的倒装
公式：Not only does 主题词increase 某方面but it also enables them to 某方面.
注：increase 可根据语境替换为bring 带来、facilitate 便利、enhance 提升等。
例2022 年英一：
Not only does attending lectures increase undergraduates' academic knowledge,
but it also enables them to expand their horizons.
听讲座不仅能增加大学生的知识，还能开拓他们的眼界。
例2023 年英一：
Not only does attending dragon boat races improve our physical and mental
health, but it also enables us to inherit and develop the traditional culture.
参加龙舟比赛不仅有助于身体和心理健康，还有助于传承和发展传统文化。
Not only does constructing parks improve people's living environment, but it also
attracts them to exercise.
建造公园不仅改善了人们的生活环境，而且还吸引人们去锻炼身体。
Not only does the soaring ownership of household appliances indicate a
significant rise in residents' disposable income, but it also demonstrates that
people place a high value on comfort and convenience life.
家用电器拥有量的飙升不仅表明居民可支配收入的显著增加，而且表明人们对
55
舒适和便利生活的重视。
Not only does the development of express delivery increase people's quality of
life, but it also enables them to live a convenient life.
快递业的发展不仅提高了人们的生活质量，也使得他们能够过着便利的生活。
Not only does health literacy improve people's quality of life, but it also enables
them to relieve stress effectively.
健康素养不仅提升了人们的生活质量，也使他们能够有效缓解压力。
Not only does participating in labor practice classes improve undergraduates'

参加劳动实践不仅能促进大学生的身心健康，还能促进社会进步。
Not only does playing chess cultivate a positive mindset in the elderly, but it also
deepens friendship and kinship.
下棋不仅有助于老年人培养积极和充满活力的心态，而且还加深了友情亲情。
方案五：虚拟语气恐吓法（扣帽子、上高度）
第一步：写主将从现句，即主句一般将来时，从句一般现在时。如果你真的对
语法一窍不通，那就别管这个了，背住即可。
第二步: 把fails 变成failed, will 变成would,其他都不变，句子就变成了虚拟语
气。
背住例句：
If everyone failed to do Sth., our society would be confronted with an unpromising
and fruitless future.
如果我们每个人都没能做某事，我们的社会就没有未来。
If we ignored the importance of Sth., we would never become a better version of
ourselves.
如果我们忽视了某事的重要性，我们就永远不会成为更好的自己。
56
If we underestimated the importance of Sth., our nation would permanently lag
behind in the new era of rapid development.​
如果我们低估了某事的重要性，我们的国家将在快速发展的新时代永远落后。
If we ignored the importance of traditional culture, our country and ethnicity
would be confronted with an unpromising and fruitless future.
如果我们忽视了传统文化的重要性，我们的国家和民族就没有未来。
If the government ignored the importance of infrastructure construction, our cities
如果政府忽视基础设施建设的重要性，我们的城市就没有未来。
If we ignored the importance of physical health, we would never become a better
version of ourselves.
如果我们忽视了健康的重要性，我们就永远不会成为更好的自己。
If we ignored the importance of social practice, we would never discover our true
potential and strength.
如果我们忽视了社会实践的重要性，我们将永远无法发现自己真正潜力和力量。
注：2025 年英一英二均不适合本方案，家电和老年人的生活难扣帽子、上高度。
如果非要用，后半句需要大改，例如If we failed to care for the elderly, our society
would become less compassionate and inclusive. 如果我们不能关爱老人，我们的
社会就会变得缺乏同情心和包容性。
注：建议原因三采用本方案，段尾给人警醒，适用性极强。
方案六：对比论证
Compared with B, A can 小方面, so as to 大方面.
In contrast to B, the advantage of A is to 某方面.
注：A 是主要内容，B 是次要内容。方面依旧来自于方案三中的五大方面。
57
例2018 年英一：
Compared with simple lessons, difficult courses can develop students' critical
thinking skills, so as to expand their horizons.
so as to 结构也可以被替换为which 引导的定语从句：
Compared with simple lessons, difficult courses can improve the capacity of
students, (which is) making it easier for students to expand their horizons.
与简单的课程相比，困难的课程可以培养学生的批判性思维能力，从而扩大他
们的视野。
或In contrast to simple lessons, the advantages of difficult courses are to improve
personal ability and expand our horizons.
相比于简单的课程，有难度课程的优势在于提升个人能力和开拓眼界。
Compared with employment, pursuing further education can expand their
horizons, so as to promote all-round development.
58
与就业相比，继续深造可以开阔视野，从而促进全面发展。
或
In contrast to employment, the advantage of pursuing further education is to
expand our horizons and enhance academic competence.
与就业相比，继续深造的好处是开阔视野，提高学术能力。
没有对比创造对比!

Compared with commercial projects, building more parks can significantly

方案七：比喻句
主题词is the engine that propels personal growth and social progress .
主题词是引擎，推动个人成长与社会进步。
主题词is the bridge between goals and accomplishments.​
主题词是桥梁，连接目标与成就。
主题词is the foundation upon which we build a sustainable future.
主题词是基石，我们借此构建可持续的未来。
主题词is as important as a lighthouse, providing guidance in difficult times.
主题词就像灯塔一样重要，在困难的时候为我们提供指引。
主题词is as essential as a compass, helping us navigate through life's challenges.
主题词像指南针一样不可或缺，帮助我们应对生活中的挑战。
常见适配的主题词：
persistence/perseverance/tenacity 坚持；self-discipline 自律；courage 勇气；
confidence 自信；patience 耐心；curiosity 好奇心；ambition 野心；integrity 诚
信；optimism 乐观；a positive mindset 积极心态；action 行动；practice 实践；
effort 努力；planning/strategy 计划；execution；learning 学习；education 教育；

cooperation/collaboration/teamwork 合作；communication 沟通；guidance 指导；

升级：加插入语
插入语可以用到作文中的任何地方，大家要树立使用插入语的意识，插入
语的位置——主谓之间；插入语的格式——逗号+插入语+逗号。给出如下万能
插入语，想插就插。
以创新为例：Creativity and innovation, needless to say, are as important as a
compass, helping us navigate through life's challenges.
创新，毫无疑问，同指南针一样重要，帮助我们度过生活的挑战。
至此，第二段原因分析的七大方案讲解完毕。第二段明明只写三点原因，
为什么讲七个方案呢？第一，考场上大家七选三，重复概率几乎为零；第二，
面对不同的题目，可以选择自己认为最合适的方案。因此建议大家，七个方案
中至少掌握五个方案，方案一、三、五必须掌握，剩下两个方案大家任选。以
2024 年英一图画图表结合为例，完整的第二段是：
There exist plenty of causes accounting for the phenomenon in various aspects.
For instance, my hometown, a beautiful city, is committed to infrastructure
construction. During this period, citizen satisfaction has improved. Furthermore, a
rising number of individuals are coming to the realization that a healthy lifestyle is
strongly dependent on infrastructure development. In the end, if the government
ignored the importance of infrastructure construction, our cities would be
confronted with an unpromising and fruitless future.
造成这一现象的原因是多方面的。例如，我的家乡，一个美丽的城市，致
力于基础设施建设。在此期间，公民满意度有所提高。此外，越来越多的人开
始认识到健康的生活方式在很大程度上取决于基础设施的发展。最后，如果政
府忽视基础设施建设的重要性，我们的城市将没有未来。
补充讲解：争议话题怎么办？
出现过的争议话题有06 年偶像崇拜、09 年网络的近与远、13 年英一毕业
生的选择、13 年英二某高校学生兼职情况、15 年英一手机时代的聚会、2019
年英二某高校本科毕业生去向、20 年某高校学生手机阅读目的调查。
上述年份一定需要正反论证吗？并非如此。写作的切入点很多，以15 年为
例，可以正反论证手机优缺点，也可以单方面论证交流重要性或拒绝沉溺手机
的重要性；20 年可以正反论证使用手机阅读的优缺点，也可以单方面论证合理
使用手机的重要性（论证重要性就是论证该现象发生的原因）。大家选择自己
熟练的方案即可。若一定需要正反论证，例如09 年网络的近与远、13 年某高
校学生兼职情况，写法如下。
第一步：替换引入原因分析的过渡句
Every situation has its pros and cons, and this issue/phenomenon is not exempt.
每种情况都有其利弊，这个问题/现象也不例外
In fact, this issue/ phenomenon remains controversial.
事实上，这个现象仍有争议。
When it comes to..., opinions vary widely.
涉及到某问题/现象时，意见分歧很大。
第二步：套公式
On the one hand, some people hold the view that…On the other hand, the rest insist
that…Nevertheless, when we are confronted with 主题词, we should be sensible
enough to discard the dross and select the essence.
一方面，一些人认为…另一方面，剩下的人认为…然而当我们面对主题词，我
们应该取其精华去其糟粕。
或Proponents of this trend argue that....However, critics are quick to point out its
61
adverse consequences, such as... It is, therefore, imperative for us to adopt a
discerning attitude, carefully weighing its merits against its demerits.​
该趋势的支持者认为...。然而，批评者迅速指出其不利后果，例如...。因此，我
们必须采取一种有辨识力的态度，仔细权衡其利弊。
注：省略号代表的是句子，是上述七个方案的句子或部分句子。
例：2009 年第二段完整写法
Every situation has its pros and cons, and this issue is not exempt. On the one
hand, some people hold the view that the popularity of the Internet plays a crucial
role in communication and information gathering among various areas. On the other
hand, the rest insist that Internet addiction may undermine the mental and physical
health among teenagers and youngsters. Nevertheless, when we are confronted with
the Internet, we should be sensible enough to discard the dross and select the
essence.
每种情况都有其利弊，这个问题也不例外。一方面，一些人认为互联网的
普及在各个领域之间的交流和信息收集方面起着至关重要的作用。另一方面，
另一些人坚持认为网瘾可能会对青少年的身心健康造成伤害。然而，当我们面
对互联网时，我们应该明智地去其糟粕，取其精华。
例：2013 年英二第二段完整写法
In fact, this issue remains controversial. On the one hand, some people hold the
view that not only does the part-time job increase students’ quality of life but also it
enables them to strengthen their minds. On the other hand, the rest insist that the
part-time job may have negative influences on the academic record among
undergraduates. It is, therefore, imperative for us to adopt a discerning attitude,
carefully weighing its merits against its demerits.
事实上，这个问题仍然存在争议。一方面，一些人认为兼职不仅能提高学
生的生活质量，而且能增强他们的心智。另一方面，其他人坚持认为兼职可能
会对大学生的学习成绩产生负面影响。因此，我们必须采取一种有辨识力的态
度，仔细权衡其利弊。
62
3.5 通用的第三段：总结全文+具体措施+畅想未来
⑦：总结全文
总结全文即重申中心思想，②句中的方案也可使用。句子开头需加：All in
all/ To sum up / In general/ Generally speaking/ On the whole。
方案一：从句（与第二段中的方案三类似）
公式：It is not difficult to draw the conclusion that enough attention must be turned
to 主题词by ourselves and our community.
It is not difficult to draw the conclusion that enough attention has been turned to
the infrastructure by the departments concerned.
不难得出结论，有关部门对基础设施给予了足够的重视。（也可以得出居民的
生活环境越来越好的结论）（注意根据情况变换时态）
It is not difficult to draw the conclusion that enough attention must be turned to the
practical courses by ourselves personally and our universities.
不难得出结论，我们个人和大学都必须对实践课程给予足够的重视。
公式：We should bear in mind that 主题词is of great importance to 某方面.
参考五大方面，主要从个人、行业、社会的角度出发考虑，例如：our personal
development 我们个人发展、both our life and study 我们的生活和学习、industry
development 行业发展、social progress 社会进步
We should bear in mind that practical courses are of great importance to our
personal development.
我们应当牢记在心的是社会实践养对我们个人发展很重要。
例2019 年英一：
We should bear in mind that the spirit of perseverance is of great importance to
both our life and study.
63
我们应当牢记在心的是坚持的精神对我们的生活和学习很重要。
注：本方案特别适用于意志品质类的作文，例如the spirit of perseverance/never
giving up/lifelong learning/selfless dedication/cooperation 坚持/永不放弃/终身
学习/无私奉献/团结协作的精神
公式：The discussion leads us to the realization that 主题词is not an option, but a
necessity.
例2023 年英一、2021 英一：
The discussion leads us to the realization that cultural inheritance is not an option,
but a necessity.
讨论使我们认识到，文化传承不是一种选择，而是一种必要。把inheritance 换
成exchange 适用于2002、2010。
例2025 年英一、英二：
The discussion leads us to the realization that high-quality life is not an option, but
a necessity.
讨论使我们认识到，高质量生活不是一种选择，而是一种必要。把high-quality
换成healthy 适用2023 英二。
公式：We are faced with the undeniable fact that 主题词has become
an integral part of our lives.
increasingly accessible to the general public.
例2009、2015 英一、2020 英二：
We are faced with the undeniable fact that the Internet has become an integral part
of our lives.我们面临着一个不可否认的事实，即互联网已经成为我们生活中不
可或缺的一部分。
例2025 英一：
We are faced with the undeniable fact that home appliances have become an
integral part of our development.我们面临着一个不可否认的事实，家用电器已
经成为我们发展中不可或缺的一部分。
64
方案二：否定词（组）倒装
结构：否定词+助动词+主谓宾。看不懂没关系，记住下方组合公式，考场上只
需要写出与主题相关的动词短语。
Never can we
On no account should we
Under no circumstance can we
By no means should we
✖
give up our efforts to...
underestimate the profound impact of...
cease our pursuit of...
doubt the importance of...
例2011 年英一：
By no means should we give up our efforts to protect the environment.
我们决不能放弃在保护环境上的努力。
Under no circumstance should we cease our pursuit of a more convenient and
intelligent lifestyle.
在任何情况下，我们都不应停止对更便捷、更智能生活方式的追求。
Never shall we give up our efforts to ensure the well-being of senior citizens.
我们永远不会放弃为确保老年人福祉而努力。
方案三：万能但不够针对
There is no denying that further attention must be paid to the scene/phenomenon/
situation/tendency mentioned above.
注：万能且无需修改任何内容，应急使用。
⑧~⑨：具体措施
方案一：一句一个角度，两句并列
五个角度：政府作为、公民意识、个人行为、媒体呼吁、家庭教育。任选两个
掌握即可，可单独使用也可用连接词相连，以2011 年“保护环境”为例，直接
背例句。
65
政府作为：It is imperative for the authorities to make strict laws to protect the
environment.当局必须制定严格的法律来保护环境。
make strict laws
→
formulate policies 制定政策
allocate more funds 拨付更多资金
launch public initiatives 发起公共倡议
公民意识：We should also enhance children and adults’ awareness of environment
protecting.我们还应该提高孩子和大人的环境保护意识。
个人行为：We ought to spare no pains to protect the environment and make the
“global village” better.我们应该不遗余力地保护环境，让“地球村”变得更好。
媒体呼吁：Mass media, such as radios, televisions, newspapers and the Internet,
should appeal to people to live a low carbon life.
大众媒体，例如收音机、电视、报纸和互联网，应该呼吁人们过低碳生活。
子女教育：Parents and teachers can set a good example for children on resource
conservation through their own behavior.
家长和老师可以通过规范自身为孩子们树立节约能源的榜样。
例2024 年英一、2025 英二：
For one thing, it is imperative for the authorities to allocate more funds. For
another, mass media, such as radios, televisions, newspapers and the Internet,
should appeal to people to live a healthy life.
一方面，当局必须不断增加投入。另一方面，媒体，如收音机、电视、报纸和
互联网，应该呼吁人们过健康的生活。
For one thing, it is imperative for the authorities to formulate policies to promote
the development of the home appliance industry. For another, enterprises ought
66
to spare no pains to enhance product quality and reduce commodity prices.
一方面，当局必须制定政策来促进家电行业的发展。另一方面，企业应该不遗
余力地提高产品质量，降低商品价格。
方案二：老子说的才是对的
第一句抛出大多数人的做法，转折词相连，第二句给出自己的看法，以彰显自
己的独到见解。
待选1：When it comes to concrete solutions, some people hold that A must assume
responsibility for B. In fact, it is C that plays a crucial role in D.
注释：
A——其他人认为的措施的实施方
例如：the government department concerned（有关部门）
B——主题词
以环境保护为例：the protection of the environment
C——你认为的措施的实施方
例如：cultivating citizen’s consciousness（培养公民意识）
D——主题词，但不要和B 一模一样
以环境保护为例的最终例句：
When it comes to concrete solutions, some people hold that the government
department concerned must assume responsibility for the protection of the
environment. In fact, it is cultivating citizens’ consciousness that plays a crucial
role in protecting the environment.
当涉及到具体的解决方案时，一些人认为有关部门必须承担起保护环境的责
任。事实上，培养公民意识在保护环境中起着至关重要的作用。
待选2 ：On the surface, A seems to be a sound solution, but when carefully
weighing in the mind, we find that B is more reasonable and effective.
A——解决措施1
例如：Setting rules based on scenic location（景区制定规则）
B——解决措施2
67
例如：improvement in citizen awareness（公民意识的改善）
On the surface, setting rules based on scenic location seems to be a sound solution,
but when carefully weighing in the mind, we find that improvement in citizen
awareness is more reasonable and effective.
从表面上看，以景区为基础制定规则似乎是一个很好的解决方案，但仔细权衡
之后，我们发现提高公民意识更合理有效。
⑩：畅想未来或其他
均为万能句
待选1：If these proposed measures are achieved, a harmonious balance between A
and B will be within our reach.（注：A、B 根据主题词来定）
如果这些提议的措施得以实现，A 和B 之间的平衡触手可及。
待选2：In this way, hopefully, we may have a better future.
这样我们才有希望拥有一个更加美好的未来。
待选3：Let us believe that this is the first step toward a brighter future for all of us.
让我们相信这是我们所有人迈向更光明未来的第一步。
待选4：Only through the joint efforts of all people can we effectively solve the
problem/ have a better life/ push the social progress.
只有通过所有人的共同努力，我们才能有效地解决问题/拥有更好的生活/推动
社会进步。
待选5：There is no better time than now for us to take collective and decisive
action to address this pressing issue.​
现在是我们采取集体和果断行动解决这一紧迫问题的最佳时机。
至此，第三段总结全文+具体措施+畅想未来讲解完毕。以2024 年英一图
画图表结合为例，完整的第三段：
infrastructure by the departments concerned. For one thing, it is imperative for the
authorities to increase investment continuously. For another, mass media, such as

healthy life. In this way, hopefully, we may have a better future.
不难得出结论，有关部门已对基础设施给予足够的重视。一方面，当局必须不
断增加投资。另一方面，大众媒体，如收音机，电视，报纸和互联网，应该呼

图表作文第三段补充写法
图表作文第三段还可以：总结全文+趋势预测，这是最简单的写法。
待选1：
Judging from all factors offered/ Taking into account all these factors, we may
reasonably draw the conclusion that with the changes of period and the advances of
the society, the number of people who choose to 做某事will keep increasing/
decreasing in the days to come.
从所提供的所有因素来看/考虑到所有这些因素，我们可以合理地得出结论：
随着时代变迁和社会进步，在未来做某事的人将会不断地增加/减少。
待选2：

may focus on/ choose to 做某事and this trend will not change in the near future.
势近期不会改变。
待选3：
Given the arguments above, in the next few years, the 主题词will also witness
larger-scale, faster-paced, and higher-quality development.
综上所述，未来几年，主题词还将迎来更大规模、更快节奏、更高质量的发展。
注：趋势预测非常万能，因为对于表示图表，无非就三种情况——增加（大概
率是增加）、减少、保持不变。
For the reasons given above, we may predict that an increasing number of families
may may focus on intelligent home appliances and this trend will not change in
家电，而且这种趋势在不久的将来不会改变。

undergraduates may focus on social practice and this trend will not change in the

leisure activities for the elderly will also witness larger-scale, faster-paced, and

综上所述，未来几年，老年人休闲活动的多样性和质量还将迎来更大规模、更

3.6 后续学习安排
至此，大作文中替换词和句型均逐一给出。替换词很多，各位不必全会拼
写，因为考场上我们只会拼写出一个两个就够了！待选句和方案很多，各位不
必全都掌握，因为考场上我们只需要默写10 句左右下来！接下来大家需要做
什么？

用一到两周时间，对照我的视频学习、消化其中的例句。
对照此资料套用真题作文，三、五篇即可发现偏好，建议：
英一同学
英二同学

3. 练习套用24、25 英一真题；
4. 学习文字作文第一段；
5. 练习套用文字作文样题；
1. 练习套用14、19 年英二真题；
2. 学习图画作文第一段；

将偏好的单词、句型、方案抄写到一张纸上，形成自己独有的大作文模板。
不做大的变动，可做小的升级，熟记于心，反复练习历年真题，做到20 分
钟内套用任意历年真题。
每周练习套用1~2 次，考前20 天，每天套用一次。
切记，不要痴心妄想，认为自己考前两周即可掌握。你那不算掌握，顶多
算会背。只背模板，却不练习，考场上很痛苦。

1. 前言
1.1 大纲解析
最新考研英语大纲如下表所示，25 考研英语真题如下图所示。英一英二在
大纲要求上无任何区分，题目上有差别——英语二的“提示”分点列出，因此
本份资料英语一英语二通用。
英语一
英语二
A 节(1 小题）：要求考生根据规定情
景写一篇约100 词(标点符号不计算在
内)的应用文，类型包括书信、通知、
告示、纪要等。共10 分。
25 考研英语一小作文
25 考研英语二小作文
2
大纲对小作文的类型做出了界定：书信、通知、告示、纪要等。其中，书
信按类型可分为表扬信、投诉信、求职信、辞职信、感谢信、道歉信、咨询信、
建议信等；通知＝告示，英文都是notice，一般是公开的宣布一件事或决定，
是换了格式的书信；纪要一般指会议纪要或者某件事的简要说明，是23 年新增
的题型，本质上与备忘录相同。
1.2 应对策略
小作文种类如此之多，那么我们真的有必要准备那么多模板吗？当然没必
要。还是大作文一样的思想，我们要学会发掘相同点和不同点，整理出一份通
用型的小作文模板。面对不同的类型时，仅需要修改格式，使用恰当的句子即
可。
什么叫做恰当的句子？抛开格式问题，仅谈小作文主要内容，即第二段。
以创新大赛为例，题目让你邀请个人参加，就是邀请信；题目让你邀请多人参
加，就是通知告示；题目让你作为选手询问比赛安排，就是咨询信；题目让你
提出举办方案，就是建议信；题目让你总结这场比赛，就是纪要。出题角度虽
然不同，但其核心内容相同，需要涉及到时间、地点、人物、事件，仅有第一
段和第三段套话不同。
小作文模板还可以和大作文模板结合起来，举个例子，若题目是推荐一本
书，那就推荐《自然之美The Beauty of Nature》，第一三段写套话，第二段写
保护环境的重要性即可。所以，我们还有必要准备那么多小作文模板吗？没必
要，正确的应对策略是分类记忆一三两段，合并学习第二段，即核心内容。本
作文模板将会给出50 个第二段经常用到的句子，记住之后历年真题均可套用。
总之，我们学习作文的思想是：用有限的知识解决无限的问题。这句话不
仅适用于学习作文，还适用于其他科目、读研以及工作。
1.3 学习方法
用一天时间（2 小时）对照视频学习本资料，再用一天时间（两小时）复
习和领悟其“灵活运用”的思想，随后立即开始套用历年真题，每周2~3 篇，
考前一个月，每天一篇。题目做完了怎么办？1.真题可以反复练习；2.英语一英
语二小作文无需区分，可相互练习。
3
2. 小作文模板
2.1 书信
我们回归本源，将投诉信、辞职信、道歉信、感谢信、请求信、建议信、
咨询信在内的所有书信类型打回原形。根据收信人进行分类，认识收件人，称
之为私人信件；不认识收件人，称之为公务信函（除了“人”还可以是机构）。
二者仅在称呼和第一段是否需要自我介绍上有区别。
称呼
仔细读题，搞清楚收信人或者收信机构是什么。翻阅历年真题，总结如下：
情况
收信方
只知道姓
Dear Mr. Lee（男）
Dear Ms. Lee（女）
只知道名
Dear Paul/ John
只知道职位
Dear Manager（经理）
Dear President（主席、校长）
Dear Editor（编辑）
Dear Professor（教授）
4
啥也不知道
Dear Sir or Madam
Dear Friends
正文
私人信件第一段：背景提要+来信意图
第一句：背景提要
发生什么事了导致“我”建议、投诉、邀请、感谢、道歉、申请、辞职、
推荐、请求、询问、回复等。
通用：
I am very pleased/ glad/excited/sorry/disappointed to hear that…
听到……我很高兴/开心/激动/抱歉/失望。
I hope this letter/email finds you well and…
展信佳（祝察看这封信的你一切安好）。
It was a great pleasure to receive your email.
收到您的来信，我深感愉快。
积极的：
It is my honor to invite you to join in 某活动/ visit 某地.
我很荣幸地邀请您参加某活动/某地。
It is my honor to inform you that…
(you have been selected as a member of the Student Union.)
我很荣幸地邀请/通知您……
(您已被选为学生会的一员)
It is my honor to 可被替换为It gives me immense pleasure to.
消极的：
I want to express my 心情through this letter regarding 主题词that…
我想通过这封信表达我对“主题词”的“心情”。
心情——disappointment 不满/ displeasure 不高兴/ apology 道歉/ regret 遗憾；
主题词——根据题干内容确定，例如a product 一个产品/ a tragedy 一个悲剧/ a
misunderstanding 一个误会
注意：上方句子中省略号代表的内容摘抄或改编自题干，改编的思路有同义词
或词组替换、主动被动转换。并非所有年份的题目都给出了足够多信息供你改
写，本句若无法根据题干信息改写，可省略。
5
例：2025 年英语一（答复信，实质是介绍信，介绍展览和工作，邀请参加）
题干中说到保罗对于你要举办的创新手工展很有兴趣，并且向帮忙，那么我们
首先要表示开心。
I am very glad to hear that you are interested in the innovative craft-making
exhibition.
我很高兴听到你对创新手工展感兴趣。
例：2025 年英语二（邀请信，介绍话剧，邀请参加）
题干中说到约翰对你策划的根据中国古典小说改编的话剧很有兴趣，那么我们
I am very glad to hear that you are interested in the play based on a classic Chinese
novel.
我很高兴听到你对根据中国古典小说改编的戏剧感兴趣。
6
第二句：来信意图
私人信件无需自我介绍，因为对方知道你是谁，因此直入主题，介绍来信意图。
I am writing this letter in order to (或I am writing to)+
express my gratitude/ appreciate your…感谢
clarify some misunderstandings/ apologize for my…道歉
suggest some improvements/ make several suggestions about…建议
complain about…/ protest against…/ object to…投诉
praise/ commend your excellent customer service 表扬
invite you to participate/ attend in ...邀请
inform you that…/ notify you of the meeting. 通知
inquire Sth. about…咨询
recommend … to you. 推荐（introduce myself.自荐）
request your assistance.求助
offer my support.帮助
apply for a position as an assistant.求职
request to resign from my present position.辞职
describe my recent plan/ provide further details about the plan 计划
specify the event arrangement. / outline my daily schedule.安排
confirm our appointment.确认
summarize the main points of the meeting.总结
highlight the importance of this matter. 强调
注1：以上内容省略号代表的是具体事件，根据题目而定。
注2：若场景较严肃，可使用正式一些的开头——
The purpose of this letter is to... 本信旨在…
I am writing with the intention of... 我写此信意在…
例2025 年英语一和英语二可以使用同一句话：
I am writing this letter in order to provide further details about the plan.
我写这封信是为了提供有关该计划的进一步细节。
注：若觉得太简单请将plan 根据题干改写。
7
例2023 年英语二（推荐信建议信）
完整的第一段是：
Dear David:
I hope this email finds you well and it is difficult to decide between the two
shows. I am writing to recommend the art exhibition.​
展信佳，在这两个展览之间做出选择很困难。我写这封信是为了推荐你去
看艺术展。
例2022 年英语一（邀请信）：
51. Directions:
Write a email to a professor at a British university, inviting him/her to
organize a team for the international innovation contest to be held at your
university. You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Li Ming" instead. Do
not write the address. (10 points)
Dear Professor:
It is my honor to inform you that the international innovation contest will be
held at my university. I am writing this letter in order to invite you to participate in
the contest with your team.
我很荣幸地通知您，我们学校将举办一场国际创新大赛。我写这封信是为
了邀请你和你的团队一起参加比赛。
8
公务信函第一段：自我介绍+来信意图
第一句：自我介绍（不可省略）
公务信函，对方（例如：某教授、某组织、某机构等）不知道你的身份，
因此需要简单地自我介绍，表明身份即可。有两种情况：1.题干已经给出；2.
题干未给出。出现第二种情况时，默认自己是学生。可以单独成句：I am a student
from the department of Art at a university./ I am an undergraduate at a university,
majoring in Art./ I am currently pursuing a degree in Art at a university.也可以融入
开头：As a student in the Art Department, I am writing to...
第二句：来信意图——同私人信件一模一样，不再赘述
第二段：具体内容或原因分析
具体内容和原因分析均参照题干要求（或提示），第一句过渡句，第二、
三、四（如有）句分点阐述。在学习之前，再次强调一点，请大家弱化对建议
信、投诉信、邀请信、感谢信、道歉信、申请信、辞职信、推荐信、请求信、
询问信等的区分，第一段区分只是为了方便你背那几个单词。一旦你给某句话
扣上了“只能用于某种信”的帽子，那么这句话的使用范围将会大大受限，因
此只能说某句话常用于某种信。
第一句：过渡句
待选句：
There stand at least two/ three factors accounting for my…
The reasons for my…are as follows.
The detailed reasons for my… can be given as follows.
My…are as follows.
There are my…about how to do Sth.
The details can be listed as follows.
省略号为建议、投诉、邀请、感谢、道歉、申请、辞职、推荐、请求、询问等
的名词形式：suggestion（或advice）、complaint、invitation、gratitude、apology、
application、resignation、recommendation、request、inquiry 等。除了上述单词，
如果大家在做题的过程中碰到新的单词，要将这个分类的名词形式补充至此。
9
第二、三、四句：分点阐述
这部分写二或三句话（评判标准是是否将事情讲清楚，是否将原因说清
楚），分点阐述。小作文的题目要求非常具体，大作文则是自由发挥，因此有
些同学认为小作文更难一些，但小作文难的是中文，而不是英文。另外，大家
在学习的时候注意将大作文模板和小作文模板结合起来。大作文模板中的第二
段和第三段内容亦可使用，例如2009 年关于白色污染的建议信，大作文模板
第三段中的五个措施完全可用。翻阅历年真题后，我选取了50 个使用率极高
的句子，请大家部分背诵，但写作时挑选2~3 句即可。再次强调请大家弱化题
型区分，强化功能表达，以下分类只是为了方便查询和背诵。

of Sunday, December 20th.

7:00

and have sound

感谢和道歉
34. I am extremely grateful to you for your unselfish assistance/ advice during the
period of ...
我非常感谢您在…期间（学习/工作）给我的无私帮助/建议。
35. It is your hospitality/ enthusiasm/ assistance that enabled me to ...
正是你的款待/热情/帮助使我能够…（参考五大方面）
36. Without your generous help, I would not have made such great progress in...
如果没有你的慷概帮助，我就不会在某方面取得重大进步。
37. Without your generous help, I would not have such a wonderful experience.
如果没有你慷概帮助，我就不会有如此美妙的经历。
38. All of us desire to improve the ability of
under your professional
guidance.
我们期望在您的指导下提升某能力。
注：34~38 句就是拍马屁，不管感谢还是道歉，都能拍。邀请信也能拍（38 句）。
39. To make up for it, I am ready to immediately correct the mistake / offer my full
assistance to resolve the matter.
为了弥补，我准备立即纠正错误/全力协助解决此事。
15
40. I assure you that I have learned a valuable lesson from this and will take
concrete steps to ensure it does not happen again.
我向您保证，我已从中吸取了宝贵教训，并将采取具体措施确保此类事情
不再发生。
注：39~40 句只用于道歉，可任选1 句背下来。但适用性并不强，历年真题中
没有纯粹的、严肃的道歉信，最多是忘记归还CD、修改拜访日期。
通用型（可搞定多种类型小作文，非常重要、全部背诵）
41. We are badly in need of
, which can help us
我们急需某物，可用于帮助我们做某事。
42. Due to
, it’s convenient/inconvenient/possible/impossible for us to
由于某物，我们做什么是方便的/不方便的/可能的/不可能的。
43. I wonder if you can
so that I can
我想如果你能做什么，我就能做什么。
44. We could have more opportunities to
if you improve
如果你能对某事进行改进，我们就有更多的机会去做某事。
45. It is advisable to
, which can really help you
做某事是明智的，这能够帮你怎样。
46. ____provides a unique opportunity to let you explore yourself with creativity.
XX 提供了一个独特的机会，让你可以用创造力探索自己。
47. Everyone agrees that your ____ is key to the satisfactory outcome.
大家都认为你的____是取得满意结果的关键。
48. ____allows you to engage with different cultures and social customs.
XX 能够让你接触不同的文化和社会习俗。
different cultures and social customs 还可以换为encyclopedic knowledge of
nature/ science/ history 广博的自然/科学/历史知识。
49. I am confident that the students will not only have the opportunity to learn
from you, but also to draw inspiration from your example.
我相信，学生们不仅有机会向您学习，而且还能从您的榜样中汲取灵感。
50. If there had been no your timely help or response, I'm afraid the consequences
16
would have been truly serious.
如果没有您的及时帮助或回复，后果恐怕会很严重。
注：41~50 句用途非常广泛，建议全背并且灵活运用。仅需要视情况将“我”
和“你”互相转化，就可以运用于各种类型的作文。
至此，小作文第二段中常用的句子讲解结束。这50 句话不需要全部背诵，
和大作文模板类似，先练习套用，随后就能发现有哪些句子被你高频使用，然
后再去背诵。再次强调，每天叽里咕噜乱背是没有用的，我们要学会调用自己
的数据库，用有限的知识解决无限的问题。下面我以真题为例带大家套用。
真题带练（只写第二段）
例2022 年英语一写给英国大学教授的邀请信：
Firstly, the contest will be held on the playground in my university at 3:00 p.m. on
Sunday, December 31st. Moreover, a series of competitive projects such as robot
competition and aircraft competition will be held to inspire students' enthusiasm for
innovation. In the end, the experience will be memorable and our prize will be very
valuable.
首先，比赛将于12 月31 日(周日)下午3 点在我的大学操场举行。此外，将举
办机器人比赛、飞机比赛等一系列竞赛项目，以激发学生的创新热情。最后，
这次经历将是难忘的，我们的奖品将是非常有价值的。
17
例2022 年英语二写给留学生的美食节邀请信：

例2023 年英语二写给David 关于看展的建议信：
What makes the art exhibition highly recommendable is the unique experience it
offers, which includes an art performing segment. What’s more, the art exhibition
provides a unique opportunity to let you explore yourself with creativity. Finally, it
allows you to engage with different cultures and social customs.
之所以极力推荐这个艺术展，是因为它提供了独特的观展体验，其中包含艺术
表演环节。更重要的是，艺术展览提供了一个独特的机会，让你用创造力探索
自己。最后，它可以让你接触到不同的文化和社会习俗。
19
例2010 年英语二感谢美国同事并邀请他来中国：
I am extremely grateful to you for your unselfish assistance during the period of the
cultural exchange program. Without your generous help, I would not have such a
wonderful experience. I wonder if you can visit my country in due course so that
you can experience the charm of traditional Chinese culture.
我非常感谢您在文化交流项目期间给我的无私帮助。如果没有你慷概帮助，我
就不会有如此美妙的经历。我想知道你是否有时间来我们国家游玩，体验中国
传统文化的魅力。
例2019 年英语一关于援助乡村小学的答复信：
First and foremost, the purpose of the “Aiding Rural Primary School” project is to
provide a platform for people who want to spread love. Undoubtedly, students in
rural primary school are badly in need of assistance, which can help them receive a
good education. I wonder if you could contribute by teaching English so that they
would benefit significantly from your instruction.
首先，“帮扶农村小学”项目的目的是为那些想要传播爱的人提供一个平台。
毫无疑问，农村小学的学生非常需要帮助，帮助他们接受良好的教育。我想知
道你是否可以教他们英语，这样他们就能在你的指导下收获颇丰。
20
例2007 年写给图书馆的建议信（投诉信）：
In the first place, we are badly in need of updating the database, which can help us
acquire the latest knowledge. In the second place, due to the noisy environment, it’s
impossible for us to study effectively. In the third place, I wonder if the library can
extend the opening hours so that we can have more hours to study.
首先，我们迫切需要更新数据库，它可以帮助我们获得最新的知识。第二，由
于环境嘈杂，我们不可能有效地学习。第三，我想知道图书馆是否可以延长开
放时间，这样我们就可以有更多的时间学习。
请大家开动脑筋，往五大方面去靠，再写三点建议。
例2024 年英语一（答复信，实质是建议信、推荐信）
In the first place, you are badly in need of doing some research to gather detailed
information, which can help you acquire their life, achievements, and contributions.
Additionally, you could have more opportunities to catch your audience's attention
if you include some interesting stories or examples related to the scientist. In the
third place, I wonder if you can share your draft with me so that I can offer you
some specific advice.
21
首先，你非常需要做一些研究来收集详细信息，这能帮助你了解他们的生活、
成就和贡献。其次，如果你能包含一些与这位科学家有关的有趣故事或例子，
你会有更多机会吸引听众的注意力。第三，我不知道你是否能把你的草稿发给
我，这样我就能给你提供一些具体的建议。
例2024 年英语二（建议信）
Located in Anhui, Hong village is one of the most popular scenic spots in China. In
the first place, we are badly in need of doing some research to gather detailed
information, which can help us acquire official data and policies. After that, I am
confident that interviewing the residents will not only have the opportunity to
understand the needs and challenges of preserving ancient buildings, but also to
obtain valuable insights.
位于安徽的宏村是中国最受欢迎的景点之一。首先，我们迫切需要做一些研究
来收集详细的信息，这可以帮助我们获得官方数据和政策。在此之后，我相信
采访当地居民不仅有机会了解保护古建筑的需求和挑战，而且还可以获得宝贵
的见解。
例2025 年英语一（答复信，实质是介绍信、邀请信）
22
The innovative craft-making exhibition will be held in the student activity center at
8:00 a.m. on Sunday, December 20th. The exhibition will feature a keynote speech
of craft-making, innovative crafts from all over the world, and a hands-on session. I
wonder if you can arrive at the exhibition area by 7:00 a.m. so that we can assist
with the final preparations together.
创意手工艺展将于12 月20 日（周日）上午8:00 在学生活动中心举行。本次
展览将以手工制作为主题演讲、世界各地的创新工艺、实践环节为特色。不知
您能否在上午7 点前到达展区，以便我们一起协助最后的准备工作。
例2025 年英语二（介绍信、邀请信）
The short play is adapted from Journey to the West, one of China's Four Great
Classical Novels. Due to your energy and temperament, it is perfect for you to play
the role of the Monkey King. This play provides a unique opportunity to let us
explore ourselves with creativity. Rehearsals will be scheduled on weekends at the
student activity center, starting next month.
短剧改编自中国四大名著之一的《西游记》。考虑到你的精力和气质，你扮演
美猴王这个角色再合适不过了。这个短剧提供了一个独特的机会，让我们可以
用创造力探索自己。排练将从下个月开始，安排在周末于学生活动中心进行。
注意学习上述例子是如何灵活运用这些有限的句型的，建议将我给出的常
用句挑出15 个左右，背会并练习灵活套用。在此基础上，学着我的方式，从
背过的作文和大作文模板中选出一些稍微万能一些的句子作为本讲义的补充，
能者多劳。同时，上方这部分内容也是通知、告示、纪要的核心内容，他们只
是格式不同而已。对于一封邀请信，如果将邀请对象换成全体学生，那么这就
是告示。例如2022 年英语二，题干中明确说到是写Email，所以这是书信，如
果题干没提，那该年份也可以写成通知、告示的形式。
23
第三段：表示情感+期待回信
第一句：表示情感
即表示感谢、歉意、致敬、问好等。
I would like to express my gratitude for your kind consideration of my
suggestion/application.
我想对您考虑我的建议/申请表示感谢。
I am grateful for the opportunity to submit my application/suggestion for your
consideration and look forward to the possibility of contributing.
我很感激有机会提交我的申请/建议供您考虑，并期待有可能做出贡献。
Please accept my sincere apology for any inconveniences that I have caused.
给您带来的不便，请接受我诚挚的歉意。
I hope all the members would enjoy the journey.
我希望所有的成员都能享受这段旅程。
For more information about the activity, please do not hesitate to contact me.
如需了解更多关于此书/电影/旅程的信息，请随时与我联系。
We would appreciate it very much if you could accept our invitation.
如果您能接受我们的邀请，我们将不胜感激。
We hope to see your wholehearted participation and make this event/activity a
grand success.
我们希望看到你的全身心参与，使这次活动取得圆满成功。
It would be our great honor if you could grace the occasion with your presence.
如若您能莅临，我们将倍感荣幸。
以下问候家人可以通用
Please give my best regards to your family.
Could you offer my best wishes to your family?
Kindly send my sincere regards to your family.
第二句：期待回信
以下通用：
Your prompt reply will be highly appreciated.
24
非常感谢您的及时回复。
I am looking forward to your reply at your earliest convenience.
我期待着您方便时的回复。
I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
我期待很快收到您的来信。
I anticipate your reply with great eagerness.
我非常急切地期待您的回复。
落款
一般都是李明，写在右下角。
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
2.2 通知=告示（notice）
通知等于告示，英文都是notice，一般是举行活动、会议、比赛等内容，
与邀请信相比，仅格式和一三两段不同，第二段相同。格式如下：
Notice
署名
December 20, 2025
第一段：通知概况+通知目的
第一句：通知概况
It's a pleasure to inform everyone that a XX will be held in our university.
很高兴地通知大家，我校将举办XX 活动。
Our university is about to host XX for students
我们大学即将为学生举办一个XX 活动。
25
Attention all students interested in XX on campus!
校园里所有对XX 感兴趣的同学请注意！
To enrich students' extracurricular life and improve communication among club
members, our club will host a wonderful activity.
为了丰富学生的课外生活，增进社团成员之间的交流与合作，我们社团将举办
一场精彩的活动。
注：XX（活动）可以是singing contest, dancing contest, reading party, micro film
contest, speech contest, cooking show, innovation contest, a summer camp 等。
第二句：通知目的
This notice is intended to introduce some details of this contest.
本通知旨在介绍本次比赛的一些细节。
This notice serves the purpose of introducing some of the activities.
这则通知的目的是介绍一些活动。
The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows.
现将相关事宜通知如下。
The following are the notifications of the relevant matters.
以下是有关事项的通知。
第二段：具体内容
与书信第二段相同，上文给出的方案全都可以使用，不再赘述，直接举例。
例2023 年英语一：
To begin with, about the duties, the selected candidates will assist in Prof. Smith's
conducting surveys, collecting and analyzing data of students’ sports activities on
campus. Secondly, about the requirements, the candidates should be enthusiastic
about sports and have sound organization, communication and planning skills. Last
but not least, this project will allow you to contribute to the development of campus
26
sports while gaining valuable experience in research.
首先，关于职责，被选中的候选人将协助史密斯教授进行调查，收集和分析学
生在校园内的体育活动数据。其次，关于要求，候选人应热衷于体育运动，并
具有良好的组织、沟通和策划能力。最后但同样重要的是，这个项目将使您能
够为校园体育的发展做出贡献，同时获得宝贵的研究经验。（职责＋要求＋好
处）
例2020 年英语一：
The contest is scheduled in our assembly hall on Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00
a.m. All students from all grades are eligible to enter the singing competition,
including national and international students. In terms of encouragement and
shortlisted participants will receive bonus points. （时间地点+受邀人员+活动奖
励）
比赛定于周五上午8 点到10 点在我们的大会大厅举行。所有年级的学生都有
资格参加歌唱比赛，包括国内和国际学生。在鼓励和奖励方面，前三名的学生
都将获得奖励和奖杯，所有入围的参与者都将获得积分。
此外，再给出3 个万能句，可放至第二段尾，在字数不够时使用：
Please arrange your time in advance and attend the activity on time.
请各位成员提前安排好时间，准时参加活动。
During the activity, please abide by the on-site order and follow the
arrangements of the staff.
活动期间，请遵守现场秩序，听从工作人员的安排。
In order to ensure the smooth progress of the activity, please actively cooperate
27
and jointly create a good activity atmosphere.
为了确保活动的顺利进行，请大家积极配合，共同营造良好的活动氛围。
第三段：发出邀请+报名方式
Put it into practice! If you are interested in singing, this will be a memorable
experience for you. We are looking forward to your enthusiastic participation.
Please email us at 123456@qq.com to sign up.
快行动吧！如果你喜欢唱歌，这对你来说将是一次难忘的经历。我们期待您的
热情参与。请发邮件至123456@qq.com 报名。
Welcome to join us. If you are interested in this activity and are willing to have a
quite different experience these days, please do not hesitate to email us at
123456@qq.com.
欢迎加入我们。如果您对这项活动感兴趣，并愿意在这些天有一个完全不同的
体验，请不要犹豫给我们发邮件到123456@qq.com。
If you are passionate about ____, this is an ideal opportunity for you! To apply,
please
email us at 123456@qq.com. Join us today, and make a difference in enhancing
____.
如果你对XX 充满热情，这对你来说是一个理想的机会！请发送电子邮件至
123456@qq.com.今天就加入我们，在XX 方面有所改变。
We look forward to your active participation and believe this activity will bring you
an unforgettable experience! Please scan the QR code below to sign up!
期待大家的积极参与，相信本次活动将为大家带来难忘的体验！请扫描下方二
维码报名！
28
2.3 纪要
Summary of Meeting 或Minutes of Meeting
纪要一般指会议纪要，格式与通知告示类似。格式如下：
Minutes of Meeting
Date: December 23, 2023
Time: From 10:00 a.m. to 11.30 a.m.
Location: A111, conference room
Objective: 会议主题，改写自题干，短语或单词即可
Attendees: 参会人，来自题干，例All freshmen
Meeting content：
Recorded by: 署名
December 23, 2023
第一句：导入/介绍
The meeting commenced with a warm welcome from the XX, followed by an
introduction to the purpose of gathering.
XX(主持人)首先对大家的到来表示热烈欢迎，随后介绍了此次会议的目的。
The XX (university representative) delivers welcoming remarks, and provides a
brief overview of the significance of 会议主题.
XX(主持人)致欢迎辞，并简要介绍了会议主题的意义。
第二句：会议目的
The meeting aims to make a brief review of the activity held last week.
本次会议的目的是对上周的活动做一个简要的回顾。
The meeting aims to make a plan for the activity to be held next week.
这次会议的目的是为下周举行的活动制定一个计划。
The meeting aims to discuss the problem/phenomenon of 主题词and find some
29
suitable solutions.
这次会议的目的是讨论主题词的问题/现象，并找到一些合适的解决方案。
上述三句话后边均可再加一句：很多同学/同事/老师参与了讨论。
Many students/colleagues/professors participated in the discussion.
第三句：大佬发言
The chairman expressed the opinion that…董事长认为
Experts believe that…专家认为
The majority of workers think that…大多数员工认为
A detailed presentation was delivered by XX, highlighting the mission, vision, and
achievements of …
发言者详细介绍了会议主题的使命、愿景和成就。
省略号代表的句子根据会议主题确定。可源于大作文模板二三两段和该小作文
模板上文句子中选择，此处不再赘述。例如: The chairman expressed the opinion
that enough attention must be turned to staff welfare by our company. 董事长表示
我们公司必须对员工的福利给予足够的重视。
如果不确定大佬是谁，可以用概括性词语the speaker
第四句：手下赞同
The majority of those attendees were in favour of the statement/plan/decision.
大多数参会人都赞成这个表述/计划/决定。
Participants engaged in an interactive discussion to address the challenges they
faced during the activity.
参会人进行了互动讨论，以解决他们在活动中面临的挑战。
第五句：最终决定
The meeting agreed to hold the activity of …
会议同意举行…活动。
As a concrete measure, the meeting decided that…
作为一项具体措施，会议决定…
The meeting concluded with a vote of thanks extended to all participants for their
active involvement and commitment that…
30
会议最后向所有参会者表示感谢，感谢他们的积极参与并致力于…
第六句：下一次会议的日期和地点（可选）
The date and location of the next meeting will be announced via email to all
participants.
下次会议的日期和地点将通过电子邮件通知所有参会者。
根据题目内容决定，如果是一次性的会议不可写，如：临时举办的活动或紧急
召开的会议等。如果是周期性的会议可写，如：一年一度的比赛/活动，每月
一次的例会等。
由于纪要并没有历年真题或样题供参考，因此无法给出例句，不过学习至
此，你应该可以发现了，纪要也不过是换个格式的书信，核心内容不改变，请
大家牢记格式。
至此，考研英语小作文讲解完毕。待选句和方案很多，各位不必全都掌握，
因为考场上我们只需要默写8 句左右下来！
接下来大家需要做什么？
用一到两周时间，对照我的视频学习、消化。
对照此资料套用真题作文，三、五篇即可发现偏好。
不再有大的变动，可做小的升级，将偏好的句子熟记于心，反复练习，
做到10 分钟内套用任意历年真题。
每周练习套用1~2 次，考前20 天，每天套用一次。
注：基础差的同学直接背诵本文例句。切记，不要痴心妄想，认为自己考
前两周即可掌握。你那不算掌握，顶多算会背。只背模板，却不练习，考场上
很痛苦。
接下来我会做什么？
带练大小作文代表性真题，你希望我带练哪一篇？请在评论区告诉我。

1. 前言
1.1 注意事项
此资料是大作文代表性真题带练，用于帮助同学们理解、灵活运用主资料
《大作文模板》，建议两份资料对比学习，能够看出在实际写作的过程中，有
哪些地方需要灵活运用。
对照配套视频学习后，应该迅速开始练习套用，现阶段每周2~3 篇，考前
一个月天每天一篇。大作文做到平时练习时20 分钟内套用完毕，考场上25 分
钟内套用完毕。基础差的同学不建议对模板做出过多的改动，出错率较高；基
础好的同学建议在熟练掌握本模板的基础上，参考手头上现有的作文书、课，
对模板进行替换、升级，该过程可持续至12 月份，随后不再进行任何改动。
以下真题带练中，加粗下划线部分是主题词，其余部分均来自主资料《大
作文模板》。也就是说，若删掉主题词，这就是十几篇完整的填空类作文模板。
这正是学渣们梦寐以求的东西。
为什么一开始不拿出来？答：熟练套用+灵活运用＞假装学习+死记硬背。
相信有一部分同学已经形成了你自己的最终模板，那你就按照你的模板来练习
套用。一个题目，写作角度很多，一定要选择最容易“自圆其说”的角度。若
现在还未形成自己的最终模板，请不要照抄此文，从我的大作文模板中挑选喜
欢的、能掌握的句子，仿照此文，赶紧整理。若考前三天你还没有准备好属于
自己的作文模板，那没啥说的了，直接背下面的作文吧。

2. 图画作文真题带练
2.1 2007 年
考场思路和做题步骤
第一步：审题并明确主题词
主题词就是与主题相关的名词、动词和词组。大家看到这幅图可能会不知
所措，不确定这是一幅图还是两幅图（亦或是三幅图），不重要，我们将公式
融合起来使用。这幅图可以表现自卑与自信、换位思考、角色不同意识不同等，
但我们要选择最简单的切入点写作，那就是自信，主题词可以是：self-confidence
自信、maintain confidence\stay confident 保持自信、cultivate\develop
self-confidence 培养自信。主题词的上义词、下义词、近义词、反义词均可成为
主题词，避免反复使用同一主题词：self-doubt 不自信
inferiority 自卑
determination 决心optimism 乐观positive attitude 积极态度stay hopeful 保持希
望hopefulness 充满希望cheerfulness 开朗等。主题词能够带来的好处参考五大
方面。
第二步：选择模板中的方案，用简要的中文提示自己
无需句句都写中文提示，建议同学们仅想好第二段原因分析和第三段总结
4
全文和建议措施的方案即可，因为其他位置的句子是固定的。
第三步：开始默写，时间控制在20~25 分钟
As is symbolically depicted in the figure above, on the playground stand two
men, excited as well as scared. The goalkeeper believes that he is so small that he
can't keep the goal, while the other player holds that the goalkeeper is so strong that
he can’t shoot the ball into the goal. The drawing, undoubtedly, highlights the core
idea that self-confidence is so indispensable that the subject deserves the highest level
of attention and consideration.
Several factors contribute to my viewpoint. To begin with, definitely no one can
deny such an obvious fact that being confident under great pressure plays a crucial
role in one’s personal growth（方案三）. What’s more, in contrast to inferiority, the
advantages of confidence are to embrace challenges and achieve personal value（方案
六）. Last but not least, if we ignored the importance of developing self-confidence,
we would never become a better version of ourselves. (方案五)
We should bear in mind that self-confidence is of great importance to both our
life and study. For one thing, we should enhance children and adults' awareness of
developing their self-confidence. For another, we ought to spare no pains to stay
self-confidence. In this way, hopefully, we may have a wonderful future.

2.2 2013 年英一
第一步：审题并明确主题词。
主题词就是与主题相关的名词、动词和词组。图中一群毕业生正在面临着
各种选择，包括求职、考研、出国、创业。因此主题词可以是：searching for jobs
求职、postgraduate entrance examination 考研、going abroad 出国、starting a
business 创业、pursuing advanced studies 深造、face choices 面临选择、make a right
choice 做出正确选择、make an optimal decision 做出好选择。图片中的四个选择
以及“选择”本身都可以成为主题词。那么究竟选用什么主题词？哪个方面好写
就用哪个，我推荐使用考研、深造、做出好的选择为本篇文章的主题词。
第二步：选择模板中的方案，用简要的中文提示自己。
第三步：开始默写，时间控制在20~25 分钟。
What looks beyond dispute in the drawing is that in the middle of the picture
stand a group of graduates, aspiring as well as ambitious, facing multiple choices,
such as searching for jobs, pursuing further study, going abroad and starting a
business. Without a doubt, the drawing emphasizes the central idea that at no time
6
should we underestimate the significance of making an optimal decision.
There are plenty of causes accounting for my opinions in various aspects. To
begin with, definitely no one can deny such an obvious fact that making proper
decisions plays a crucial role in alleviating difficulties and promoting our quality of
life. (方案三) For instance, my roommate, Kevin, chose to pursue further study
after he graduated from university, which provided him with a broader platform to
enhance himself. During that period, he was vigorous and confident while other
roommates were worried about their future. (方案一) Last but not least, if we ignored
the importance of making an optimal decision, we would never become a better
version of ourselves. (方案五)
All in all, it is not difficult to draw such a conclusion that enough attention
must be turned to making the right choice by ourselves and society. Parents and
teachers can set a good example for children through their own behavior. In this way,
hopefully, we may have a wonderful future.
2.3 2017 年英一
主题词就是与主题相关的名词、动词和词组。左图一个年轻人躺在椅子上
说“我有这么多书”却不读书，右图一个年轻人坐在书桌前读书并且制定了一年
7
读20 本书的计划。因此该年份的主题词可以是：reading 读书、take action 采取
行动、the execution 执行力、strong execution 执行力、put into practice 行动起来，
也就是读书的上义词和下义词都可以成为主题词，避免整篇文章反复使用同一
个主题词。
关于读书、行动，我们还可以做以下拓展：constant effort 持续努力、actions
speak louder than words 行胜于言、down-to-earth person 脚踏实地的人。不一定
适用于本篇作文，但适用于其他以行动为主题的作文。
As is shown in the left picture, a young man, lying in the chair, says that “I have
so many books.” While in the right one, another young man who is reading sets a goal
of reading twenty books this year. The figurative representation in the paintings may
lead to the conclusion that the execution is so indispensable that the subject deserves
the highest level of attention and consideration.
There are plenty of causes accounting for my opinions in various aspects. Firstly,
for instance, my roommate, Kevin, is passionate about reading, which expands his
horizons and enriches his spiritual life. During that period, all of us admired his
capacity. (方案一) Secondly, it is commonly known that taking action plays a crucial
role in the realization of our personal goals and values. (方案三) Thirdly, if we failed
to put into practice to achieve goals, we would never become a better version of
ourselves. (方案五)
We should bear in mind that strong execution is of great importance to both our
life and study. For one thing, we ought to spare no pains to take action to make our
daily life fruitful. For another, parents and teachers can set a good example for
children through their own behavior. Let us believe that this is the first step toward a
brighter future for all of us.

2.4 2023 年英一
主题词就是与主题相关的名词、动词和词组。画面中一对老人正在讨论村
里的龙舟比赛：“真好啊，我们村的龙舟比赛越来越热闹了”。此年份主题非常
明显，就是龙舟比赛。那么龙舟比赛又和传统文化、民俗风俗息息相关，因此
该年份的主题词可以是：dragon boat racing 赛龙舟、traditional culture 传统文
化、inheritance of traditional Chinese culture 传承中华文化、attending traditional
cultural activities 参与传统文化活动、cultural heritage 文化遗产等，也就是赛龙
舟的上义词和下义词都可以成为主题词，避免整篇文章反复使用同一个主题词。
关于传统文化，我们还可以做以下扩展：traditional festival传统节日、cultural
confidence 文化自信、cultural boom 文化繁荣、intangible cultural heritage 非物
质文化遗产、national rejuvenation 民族复兴、cultural and historical identity 文化
历史认同、cultural diversity 文化多样性、modernization 现代化。不一定适用于
本篇作文，但适用于其他以文化为主题的作文。

全文和建议措施的方案即可，因为其他位置的句子都是固定的。
As is symbolically depicted in the figure above, in front of us stand a couple of
seniors, discussing the dragon boat race in their village. They find that the race is
getting increasingly lively in their village. The purpose of the drawing seems to
remind us that traditional culture is so indispensable that the subject deserves the
highest level of attention and consideration.
begin with, for instance, my grandparents, both 70 years old, are passionate about
traditional culture, which enriches their rural life. During this period, they no
longer feel lonely. ( 方案一) What’s more, the majority of people believe that
attending traditional cultural activities will provide them with a broader platform
to inherit and develop the traditional culture, which may put them in a beneficial
position in the future. ( 方案二) Last but not least, not only does inheriting
traditional Chinese culture improve our physical and mental health, but it also
enables us to expand our horizons（方案四）.
It is not difficult to draw the conclusion that enough attention must be turned to
traditional culture by ourselves and our society. When it comes to concrete
solutions, some people hold that the government department concerned must assume
responsibility for the promotion of cultural heritage. In fact, it is cultivating youth's
consciousness that plays a crucial role in the inheritance and promotion of
traditional culture.

3. 图表作文真题带练
3.1 2012 年英二
什么是主题词？与主题相关的名词、动词和词组统称为主题词。该年份主
题词可以是：job satisfaction 工作满意度、economic pressures 经济压力、work
stress 工作压力、family stress 家庭压力、face challenges from different aspects 面
对来自多方面的挑战、create a harmonious working environment 创造和谐的工作
氛围。还可以拓展：happiness index 幸福指数、employee benefit 员工福利、five
social insurance and one housing fund 五险一金、bonus 奖金、remuneration 报酬。
全文、建议措施或者趋势预测的方案即可，因为其他位置的句子都是固定的。
The chart above shows the information about employees’ job satisfaction in a
company. To be specific, employees over 50 years old have the largest proportion of
satisfaction, which accounts for 40%, while employees aged between 41 and 50 who
11
are dissatisfied account for 64%. This is not an uncommon phenomenon in our lives.
Two key reasons, in my humble opinion, could account for this phenomenon.
For one thing, definitely no one can deny such an obvious fact that middle-aged
people play a crucial role in supporting family, which may put them under high
pressure from different aspects（方案三+方案二）. For another, compared with
middle-aged people, employees over 50 years old can spend more time with their
family, so as to relieve stress and enrich life. (方案六)
There is no denying that further attention must be paid to the phenomenon
mentioned above. For one thing, it is imperative for the authorities to make strict
laws to protect employees’ interests. For another, enterprises ought to spare no pains
to create a harmonious working environment. Only through the joint efforts of all
people can they have a better life.
注：本篇是图表作文中最难的一年。
3.2 2018 年英二
主题词就是与主题相关的名词、动词和词组。图表中涉及到服务、价格、
环境、特色等因素，因此该年份的主题词可以是：service、price、environment、
feature\ characteristic，还可以拓展到food from all over the world 来自世界各地的
12
美食、dining experience 用餐体验等。该年份的难点在于写作视角，是从消费者
还是商家的角度出发呢？商家。因为好写。如果从消费者的角度出发，请问第
角度出发，建议餐厅创新菜品、提升服务、优化环境，就很流畅了。
As is exhibited by the numbers in the pie chart, people pay attention to various
factors when choosing restaurants. To be specific, features, environment, service,
price and others account for 36.30%, 26.80%, 23.80%, 8.4% and 4.7% respectively.
Specially, features rank the first and environment ranks the second.
The chart demonstrated the succeeding observable facts: people pay more
attention to the features, environment and service when they choose a
restaurant. Many factors contribute to the phenomenon reflected in this chart.
Firstly, for instance, my roommate, Kevin, is passionate about food from all over the
world, which makes him focus on the restaurant's features（方案一）. Secondly,
definitely no one can deny such an obvious fact that the great service and elegant
environment will provide them with a kind of light mood, which makes them no
longer focus on price（方案二）.
All in all, there is no denying that further attention must be paid to the
phenomenon mentioned above by restaurants. Restaurants ought to spare no pains
to create a good environment and enhance the service level. For another, it is the
restaurants that should persist in innovation to maintain characteristics. In this
way, hopefully, restaurants may have a promising prospect.
注1：本篇是图表作文中倒数第二难的一年。

3.3 2022 年英二
题词可以是：express delivery industry 快递业、total 总体的、rural 乡村的、express
delivery volumes 快递业务量、order 订单、online shopping 网购、transportation
交通运输。
As is exhibited in the bar chart, the numbers of domestic express volumes had
visible changes during the period from 2018 to 2020. To be specific, the total
number of express orders was 83 billion in 2020, compared with 51 billion in 2018,
showing an increase of 32 billion. While the number of rural express orders in
2020 was 2 times more than that in 2019. It is apparent from the statistics that rural
express delivery volumes have been developing rapidly in recent years.
Many factors contribute to the tendency reflected in this chart. For one thing,
14
definitely no one can deny such an obvious fact that online shopping and developed
transportation play a crucial role in the development of the express industry. (方
案三). For another, not only does the development of express delivery increase
people's quality of life, but also enables them to live a convenient life. (方案四)
It is not difficult to draw such a conclusion that enough attention must be
turned to the phenomenon by ourselves personally and our community. Taking into
account all these factors, we may reasonably draw the conclusion that an increasing
number of rural residents may choose to shop online and this trend will not change
in the upcoming years.

2025 年英一
主题词就是与主题相关的名词、动词和词组。图表展现了近年来全国居民
平均每百户年末主要耐用消费品拥有量（本年最难的部分就是翻译这句话），
因此该年份的主题词是the average ownership of major durable consumer goods
per 100 households in China、air conditioners、washing machines、refrigerators。
家电拥有量提升背后的原因是什么呢？背后的驱动力和给我们生活带来的好处：
the rise in disposable income 可支配收入增加，economic growth and prosperity、
government subsidies 政府补贴，thriving consumer market 繁荣的消费市场。主
题词还可以写成：these appliances / these goods / these devices（指代上文提到的
物品，避免重复），避免整篇文章反复使用同一个主题词。此外还可以拓展以
下词汇：high-speed Internet 高速互联网、public transportation 公共交通、
expressway 高速公路、healthcare system 医疗系统、online payment system 在线
支付系统，不适用于本篇作文，但适用于以生活便利为主题的作文。
17
The table above provides the variation about the average ownership of major
durable consumer goods per 100 households in China from 2014 to 2023. To be
specific, the ownership of air conditioners surged dramatically from 75.2 units in
2014 to 145.9 units in 2023. Meanwhile, the number of refrigerators increased
modestly from 85.5 to 103.4 during the same period. (or: From 2014 to 2023, the
ownership of air conditioners per 100 households surged dramatically from 75.2 to
145.9 units, while the figures for washing machines and refrigerators rose steadily
from 83.7 and 85.5 to 98.2 and 103.4 units, respectively.) It is apparent from the
statistics that the living standards of Chinese people have been developing rapidly
in recent years.
Firstly, the majority of residents believe that household appliances will provide
them with great convenience, which is indispensable in their daily life.（方案二）
Secondly, there is no doubt that government subsidies on appliances are a driving
force behind consumption. （方案三）Thirdly, not only does this significant
increase indicate a huge rise in residents' disposable income, but it also
demonstrates that people place a high value on comfort and convenience life.（方
案四）
We are faced with the undeniable fact that home appliances have become an
integral part of our daily life. For one thing, it is imperative for the authorities to
formulate policies to promote the development of the home appliance industry.
For another, enterprises ought to make continuous efforts to enhance product
quality and reduce commodity prices. In this way, hopefully, we may have a better
future.

免整篇文章反复使用同一个主题词。

The bar chart highlights the dominance of watching TV in the daily leisure life
of the elderly, which overshadows all other activities. The participation rate in

The discussion leads us to the realization that high-quality life is not an option,

in the next few years, the diversity and quality of leisure activities for the elderly

2024 年英一
主题词就是与主题相关的名词、动词和词组。左图中一群年轻人正在公园
中散步、跑步，其中一人说到：“家门口新建的小公园真不错！”；右表中展

息息相关。因此该年份的主题词可以是：building a park 建设公园、the
construction of parks 公园建设、green space construction 绿地建设、infrastructure
construction 基础设施建设、the construction of public facilities 公共设施建设，也
就是公园建设的近义词和上义词都可以成为主题词，避免整篇文章反复使用同
一个主题词。
关于基础设施建设，我们还可以做以下扩展：public infrastructure facilities
公共基础设施、transport infrastructure 交通基础设施
、communication
infrastructure 通信基础设施、infrastructure improvement 基础设施改善、
infrastructure development 基础设施发展、urban/rural infrastructure 城市/农村基
21
础设施、infrastructure investment and planning 基础设施投资和规划。不一定适
用于本篇作文，但适用于其他以基础设施为主题的作文。
The cartoon on the left side provides us with a lively scene: several urban
residents are doing exercise in the park while a youngster says that the new park is
fantastic. Referring to the statistics provided in the right chart, the number of parks
in a certain city had remarkably increased from 406 in 2020 to 670 in 2022. The

have been made in the construction of public facilities by the government.
For instance, my hometown, a beautiful city, is committed to infrastructure
construction. During this period, citizen satisfaction has improved （方案一）.
Furthermore, a rising number of individuals are coming to the realization that a

It is not difficult to draw the conclusion that enough attention has been turned

5. 文字作文大纲样题带练
5.1
文字作文大纲样题1
52.Directions :
Read the following excerpt from an article and write an essay. In your essay,
you should explain whether or to what extent you agree with the author. Support
your argument with reasons and relevant examples.
Write your answer in 160-200 words on the ANSWER SHEET.(20points )
Many of us,whatever our field of work, fear that showing uncertainty can damage our
image - and we may compensate by expressing overconfidence in an attempt to win
trust. But in many situations people are willing to trust those who can admit they don't
have a definitive answer, Recent studies found that communicating uncertainty and
even admitting our mistakes is not harmful and can even be beneficial to
trustworthiness. So, failure in “expertise” can be compensated by higher integrity and
benevolence. When communicating uncertainty in a transparent way, we are perceived
as less biased and willing to tell the truth.
什么是主题词？与主题相关的名词、动词和词组统称为主题词。文字作文
的主题词可以来源于题目给的文字段落，大家在阅读的时候就可以勾画下来。
本段文字主题词是：higher integrity and benevolence，但实际上本段中有很多词
语可以用，它们是该词的下义词、同义词、以及与主题词相关的词语，例如：
communicating uncertainty 交流不确定性、admitting our mistakes 承认错误、
trustworthiness 可信任度、less biased 不那么偏见的、willing to tell the truth 愿意
说出真相。
23
It cannot be denied that integrity and benevolence play a key role in people’s
work and life. The author believes that we are perceived as less biased and willing to
tell the truth when we show uncertainty in a transparent way. I agree with the
author’s point of view.
Three key reasons, in my humble opinion, could account for this standpoint. To
begin with, the majority of people hold that communicating uncertainty in a
transparent way will offer them an opportunity to win trust, which may put them
in a beneficial position in the future.（方案二）What’s more, an increasing number of
people are beginning to realize that trustworthiness is strongly dependent on
sincere communication.（方案三）Last but not least, if everyone failed to admit
our mistakes and tell the truth, our society would be confronted with an
unpromising and fruitless future.（方案五）
All in all, we should bear in mind that higher integrity and benevolence are of
great importance to both our life and study. When it comes to concrete solutions,
some people hold that parents and teachers must assume responsibility for the
education of integrity. In fact, it is cultivating students' consciousness that plays a
crucial role in increasing trustworthiness. The definite moment has come for us to
take action.
24
5.2
文字作文大纲样题2
48.Directions :
Write your answer in about 150 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Studies in the U.S. and the U.K. consistently show that children have lost the
right to wander. This is why many of our youth turn to technology. They aren't
addicted to the computer; they're addicted to interaction, and being around their
friends. Children, and especially teenagers, don't want to only socialize with parents
and siblings; they want to play with their peers. That's how they make sense of the
world. And we've robbed them of that opportunity. We're raising our children in
captivity and they turn to technology to socialize, learn and relax. Why are we
blaming the screens?
本段文字主题词是：network addiction 网瘾、surfing the Internet 冲浪、
technology 科技、use the Internet reasonably 合理使用网络等。
Due to the progress of society and the improvement of technology, network
addiction among children has become a common phenomenon in our daily life.
While the author believes that we can not blame the screens because children have
lost the right to make sense of the world. I agree with the author’s point of view to
some extent.
25
begin with, for instance, my younger brother, Kevin, is addicted to surfing the
Internet, which brings him the opportunity to socialize with his peers. During this
period, he enjoys the convenience brought by the Internet.（方案一）What’s more,
the majority of people hold that technology, especially the Internet, will provide
them with a broader platform to make new friends, which may put them in a
beneficial position in the future.（方案二）But if teenagers failed to use the Internet
reasonably, our society would be confronted with an unpromising and fruitless
future.（方案五）
All in all, we should bear in mind that the use of technology is of great
importance to both our life and study. For one thing, we should enhance children’s
awareness of using the Internet appropriately. For another, parents and teachers
can set a positive example for children by how they behave themselves. The definite
moment has come for us to take action.

前言
此份资料是小作文代表性真题带练，13 篇真题，手把手套用，
帮你理解、灵活运用主资料《小作文模板》，建议两份资料对比学习，
能够看出在实际写作的过程中，有哪些地方可以直接照抄，有哪些地
方需要灵活运用。
在课程评论区中，同学们反馈的最多是道歉信、感谢信套不上。
容我再次强调：大家尽量不要刻意区分小作文的类别，分类越多，工
作量越多，十几个模板你记得住吗？正确的应对策略是分类记忆一三
两段，合并学习第二段（即核心内容）。小作文模板中提供了50 个
使用率极高的句子，大家务必熟练掌握其中20 个左右。
英语一和英语二小作文无需做任何区分，因此本份资料通用。13
篇真题包含道歉信、感谢信、答复信、建议信、告示，有易有难，建
议大家先练习，后听课。

2025 年英语一回复信（实质是介绍信、邀请信）
Dear Paul,
I am very glad to hear that you are interested in the innovative craft-making
exhibition. I am writing this letter in order to provide further details about the plan.
The details can be listed as follows. The innovative craft-making exhibition will
be held in the student activity center at 8:00 a.m. on Sunday, December 20th. The
exhibition will feature a keynote speech of craft-making, innovative crafts from all
over the world, and a hands-on session. I wonder if you can arrive at the exhibition
area by 7:00 a.m. so that we can assist with the final preparations together.
I would appreciate it very much if you could accept my invitation. I am looking
forward to hearing from you soon.
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
我很高兴听到你对创新工艺制作展览感兴趣。我写这封信是为了提供有关该
计划的进一步细节。
具体情况如下。创意手工艺展将于12 月20 日（周日）上午8:00 在学生活
动中心举行。本次展览将以手工制作为主题演讲、世界各地的创新工艺、实践环
节为特色。不知您能否在上午7 点前到达展区，以便我们一起协助最后的准备工
作。
如果您能接受我的邀请，我将不胜感激。我期待很快收到你的来信。

2024 年英语一回复信（实质是建议信）
I am very glad to hear that you are preparing to deliver an oral report on an
ancient Chinese scientist. I am writing this letter in order to make several suggestions
about your report.
The details can be listed as follows. In the first place, you are badly in need of
doing some research to gather detailed information, which can help you acquire their
life, achievements,and contributions. Additionally, you could have more opportunities
to catch your audience's attention if you include some interesting stories or examples
related to the scientist. In the third place, I wonder if you can share your draft with me
so that I can offer you some specific advice.
Please give my best regards to your family. I am looking forward to hearing from
you soon.（或I hope you will find these suggestions helpful. Please do not hesitate to
contact me if you wish to discuss any of the points further.）
我很高兴听到你准备做一个关于中国古代科学家的口头报告。我写这封信是
为了对你的报告提几点建议。
具体情况如下。首先，你非常需要做一些研究来收集详细的信息，这可以帮
助你了解他们的生活，成就和贡献。此外，如果你包括一些与科学家有关的有趣
的故事或例子，你可以有更多的机会抓住听众的注意力。第三，我想知道您是否
可以将您的草稿分享给我，以便我给您一些具体的建议。
请代我向你的家人问好。我期待很快收到你的来信。（我希望这些建议对你
有帮助。如果您想进一步讨论任何要点，请不要犹豫与我联系）

2024 年英语二介绍信、建议信
Dear Jack,
I am highly pleased to learn that we will be conducting a survey on the
preservation of historical buildings in an ancient town. I am writing to outline my
preliminary plan and seek your valuable opinion.
The details can be listed as follows. Firstly, we can start with some desk research
on official policies and the village's history. Then, during our field trip, we will take
photos, interview residents and officials, and document the buildings' conditions.
Finally, we will analyze all findings and write a report with practical suggestions.
What's your opinion on it? Please let me know if you have any suggestions.
我非常高兴地得知，我们将对一个古镇的历史建筑进行保护调查。我写信是
为了概述我的初步计划，并征求你宝贵意见。
具体情况如下。首先，我们可以从一些关于官方政策和该村历史的案头研究
开始。然后，在我们的实地考察中，我们将拍摄照片，采访居民和村官，并记录
建筑物的状况。最后，我们将分析所有的发现，并写一份报告，并提出切实可行
的建议。
你对此有什么看法？如果你有什么建议，请告诉我。
注：本例文第二第三段没有使用模板内容，若想查看全部使用模板句套出来的例
文，请查看小作文模板第21 页。这是近几年最难的一篇，难点在于做计划，即
想不到实地调查都有哪些环节。即便想到了，却不知道套用哪些模板句。
8
因此，在此提供可用于“制定计划、征求意见”的句子补充学习。
制定计划（用于第二段）
1. The proposed plan consists of the following three phases: initial preparation,
on-site investigation, and data analysis.该计划包含以下三个阶段：初期准备、
实地调研和数据分析。
2. Our first step would be to conduct desk research to gather relevant background
information.我们的第一步将是进行案头研究，以收集相关的背景信息。
3. This will be followed by a field trip, during which we will 具体行动. 在此之后
实地考察，期间我们将...
4. The final phase will involve compiling all the data and drafting a report with
actionable recommendations.最后阶段将包括整合所有数据并起草一份包含
可行建议的报告。
注：具体行动需要自己根据题目选择，例如——take photographs 照相、interview
locals 采访当地人。
征求意见（用于第三段）
5. What are your thoughts on this proposed approach? I am keen to hear your
perspective.您对这个提议的方案有何看法？我非常渴望聆听您的见解。
6. Please do not hesitate to point out any potential issues or omissions you might
foresee.如果您预见到任何潜在的问题或疏漏，请务必指出。
7. I am looking forward to a productive collaboration and hope to finalize the plan
with your valuable input.我期待一次富有成效的合作，并希望能借助您的宝
贵意见最终确定计划。

Dear David,

the art exhibition provides a unique opportunity to let you explore yourself with
creativity. Secondly, attending an art exhibition allows you to engage with different
cultures and social customs. Last but not least, there is no doubt that the profound
experience will be memorable and the souvenir will be very valuable.
I would like to express my gratitude for your kind consideration of my
suggestion. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
看到这封信件的时候希望你一切都好，我听说你纠结是去艺术展还是去

俗。最后，毫无疑问地是这次经历将是难忘的，纪念品将是宝贵的。

2014 年英语二介绍信、求助信
47. Directions:
Suppose you are going to study abroad and share an apartment with John, a local
student. Write him to email to
1) tell him about your living habits, and
2) ask for advice about living there.
I hope this email finds you well and I'm truly excited about studying abroad and
sharing the apartment with you. I'm writing to briefly introduce my living habits and
ask for your valuable advice.
The details can be listed as follows. To begin with, it is necessary for me to go to
bed early, which can really help me keep a clear head the next day. Meanwhile, I
wonder if you can accept slight noise, so that I can play the guitar in the bedroom.
Finally, I would be extremely grateful if you could offer me some advice about living
there.
Please don't hesitate to let me know if you have any questions or living habits. I
am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
希望看到这封邮件的你一切安好，出国留学并且和你一间公寓，我真的很兴
奋。我写信是为了简单地介绍我的生活习惯，并寻求你的宝贵意见。
具体情况如下。首先，我需要早点睡觉，这可以帮助我在第二天保持清醒的
头脑。同时，我想知道你是否可以接受轻微的噪音，这样我就可以在卧室弹吉他
了。最后，如果你能给我一些关于在那里生活的建议，我将非常感激。
如果你有任何问题或生活习惯，请毫不犹豫地告诉我。期待你的回信。
注：例文几乎来自于前面学习过的内容，但是难点在于想到并且描述自己的生活
习惯、生活方式、性格特点等。例如，噪音-音乐这个点就不好想到。
15
因此，在此提供可用于个人介绍的句子作为《小作文模板》第13 页“能力展
示和要求”（适用于求职、求学和招募）的补充。
个人介绍
1. I consider myself an easy-going and responsible person who values honesty and
open communication.我认为自己是个随和且有责任感的人，看重诚实与开放
的沟通。
2. Those who know me often describe me as a highly motivated and reliable
individual.认识我的人常形容我是一个积极进取且可靠的人。
3. With a curious mind, I am always eager to explore new things and embrace
challenges.我怀有好奇心，总是渴望探索新事物并迎接挑战。
4. I am a creature of habit and prefer a well-organized routine, which helps me
stay efficient and focused.我习惯规律，偏爱井井有条的日常，这能帮我保持
高效和专注。
5. In my daily life, I lean towards quiet activities, such as reading or listening to
music, to unwind. 日常生活中，我倾向于用阅读或听音乐等安静的活动来放
松。
6. I am quite tidy and conscientious about maintaining a clean and pleasant shared
environment.我比较爱整洁，会自觉维护干净舒适的共享环境。
7. While I am independent and can work on my own initiative, I deeply value
sharing ideas and working collaboratively.虽然我能独立工作并主动行事，但
我非常重视分享想法和团队合作。
8. I strongly believe that clear communication and consideration for others can
prevent most misunderstandings.我坚信，清晰的沟通和为他人体谅能够避免
大多数误会。
16
2012 年英语二投诉信
Directions: Suppose you have found something wrong with the electronic dictionary
that you bought from an online store the other day. Write an email to the customer
service center to 1) make a complaint, and 2) demand a prompt solution.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2. Do not sign your own name
at the end of the letter. Use “Zhang Wei” instead.
Dear Sir or Madam,
I am extremely disappointed to find that something is wrong with the electronic
dictionary that I bought from you a few days ago. I am writing this letter in order to
complain about the product.
I am badly in need of it, which can help me learn English. Unfortunately, due to
the screen damage, it is impossible for me to use it normally. I wonder if you can
exchange the electronic dictionary, so that I can withdraw my complaint.
I will be grateful if my complaints are considered and positive changes take
place in these regards. I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
Zhang Wei
我很失望地发现我几天前从你们那里买的电子词典出了问题。我写这封信是
为了投诉产品。
我非常需要它，它可以帮助我学习英语。不幸的是，由于屏幕损坏，我无法
正常使用。我想知道你们是否可以换货，这样我就可以撤回我的投诉。
如果我的投诉得到考虑，并在这些方面发生积极的变化，我将不胜感激。我
期待很快收到你的来信。
17
2010 年英语二感谢信
You have just come back from the U.S. as a member of a Sino-American cultural
exchange program. Write a letter to your American colleague to
1) express your thanks for his/her warm reception;
2) welcome him/her to visit China in due course.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Zhang Wei" instead. Do not
Dear Mr. Lee,
I hope this letter finds you well and it is my honor to participate in the
Sino-American cultural exchange program. I am writing this letter in order to
appreciate your warm reception.
Due to your enthusiasm and patience, it’s possible for me to acquire enormous
knowledge of American culture. Interesting activities such as cultural performance,
cultural exchange meeting and visiting the museum of history inspire my enthusiasm
for American culture. I wonder if you can visit my country in due course so that you
can experience the charm of traditional Chinese culture.
you soon.
我很荣幸能参加中美文化交流项目。我写这封信是为了感谢您的热情接待.
你的热情和耐心才让我有可能获得大量美国文化知识。文化演出、文化交流
会、参观历史博物馆等有趣的活动激发了我对美国文化的热情。我想知道你是否
可以在有空的时候访问我的国家，体验中国传统文化的魅力。
请代我向你的家人问好。我很期待的回复。
18
2008 年道歉信
Directions: You have just come back from Canada and found a music CD in your
luggage that you forgot to return to Bob, your landlord there. Write him a letter to 1)
make an apology, and 2) suggest a solution.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)
Dear Bob,
I am very sorry to tell you that I forgot to return your music CD. I am writing
this letter in order to apologize for my carelessness and find a solution.
Due to the distance, it’s inconvenient for me to return the CD to your face to face.
I wonder if you can provide your home address, so that I can return the CD by express
delivery. If you have any better suggestions, please let me know.
我很抱歉的告诉你，我忘记归还你的音乐CD 了。我写这封信是为我的粗心
道歉并寻求解决办法。
由于距离的关系，我不方便当面把CD 还给你。我想知道你是否可以提供你
的家庭住址，以便我用快递退回CD。如果你有更好的建议，请告诉我。
给您带来的不便，请接受我诚挚的歉意。我期待很快收到你的来信。

26 考研英语作文主题词预测
本资料针对主题词做出分类、汇总及预测，对大作文五大类主题词做重要度
排序，时间有限的同学按重要程度背主题词。
一、概率统计
汇总2010~2025 年英语一和英语二真题后，将其分为五大类：个人品质、教
育文化、个人发展、社会发展、日常生活。随后，总结出“必备100 词”供大家参
考。

二、主题词必备“100 词”
英语一：23 考研及以前图画作文、24 考研图画+图表、25 考研图表作文。
英语二：一直以来都是图表作文。
需要注意的是23 考研大纲中增加文字作文，26 考研大纲提供“双图表”例
文，需注意。文字作文的讲解见资料1 第35 页；图画+图表作文的讲解见资料1
第21 页24 考研真题；双图表作文不过是简要的描述两个图表，只不过限于篇幅，
无需每个元素都描述，本文最后新增大纲样题补充讲解。无论英语一还是英语
二都有可能考到图画、图表、文字作文以及它们之间的结合。只不过今年都考
图表的概率高。
另，根据上文主题汇总，日常生活考查频率越来越高，需引起重视。但，无
论英语一还是英语二都应该准备五大类主题词，因为近两年的命题还未形成新
的趋势，样本量太少以至于无法代表总体。

三、双图表补充讲解
理论分析：图表按类型分有四种——表格、柱状图、线状图、饼状图，理论
上有6 种组合方式，但大概率是动态图和静态图结合，即：
双图表作文依然是议论文，只有第一段与之前学过的内容略有区别。第一段
写法如下：
原本细节描述中有两句话，一句话描述变量1，一句话描述变量2（动态图）；
一句话描述各元素占比，一句话描述占比最大的元素（静态图）。现修改为一句
话描述变化最大的变量，一句话描述占比最大的元素。非常简单，不要被纸老
虎吓到了。
以26 考研英语大纲样题为例：
The two charts depict the evolution of Internet adoption in China. From 2015 to
2021, the number of netizens grew significantly from 688 to 1032 million, with the
penetration rate rising from 50.3% to 73.0%. The primary barrier for non-users was a
lack of digital skills. This is not an uncommon scene in our society.
这两个图表描绘了中国互联网的演变。从2015 年到2021 年，网民数量从
6.88 亿增长到10.32 亿，普及率从50.3%上升到73.0%。非用户的主要障碍是缺
乏数字技能。这在我们的社会中并不罕见。
主题阐述句还可以使用图画作文中的方案5：It is the digital divide that must
第二段开始分析互联网普及率上升的原因和数字鸿沟带来危害。
Many factors contribute to the tendency reflected in this chart. Primarily,
definitely no one can deny such an obvious fact that the rapid development of
digital infrastructure(, particularly the widespread coverage of 5G networks, )is the
cornerstone of the Internet. Concurrently, not only does the Internet increase
people's quality of life, but it also enables them to live a convenient life. However, if
we underestimated the menace of digital divide, non-users would permanently lag
behind in the new era of rapid development.
许多因素促成了这张图表所反映的趋势。首先，没有人能否认这样一个明显
的事实，即数字基础设施的快速发展（特别是5G 网络的广泛覆盖）是互联网的
基石。同时，互联网不仅提高了人们的生活质量，而且使他们的生活更加便利。
然而，如果我们低估了数字鸿沟的威胁，非用户将永远落后于快速发展的新时代。
第三段总结全文+建议措施+展望未来。
We are faced with the undeniable fact that the Internet has become an integral
part of our lives. It is imperative for the authorities to allocate more funds to promote
the popularization of the Internet. Let us believe that this is the first step toward a
brighter future for all of us.
我们面临着一个不可否认的事实，即互联网已经成为我们生活中不可或缺的
一部分。当局必须拨出更多的资金来促进互联网的普及。让我们相信，这是我们
所有人迈向更光明未来的第一步。

第一层：单词
以真题词汇为主，先把真题中反复出现的词搞定。
解决影响理解、做题的词（题干、文章、选项）。
回到原句理解，不只是记一个孤立的中文意思。
高频问题：真题单词够不够？
literacy↗
2018 年 Text 2 阅读 · 2026 年翻译
第二层：长难句
不需要重新学语法课，性价比不高。
做题时，把自己没读懂、影响文章理解或做题的长难句单独拎出来。
如果长难句问题比较明显，可以集中用几天复盘过去做过的真题中的长难句。

一刷基本认知

第四层：做题思路——把完整链路跑通
每一道题，都要把“题干—原文—选项”的完整链路跑通。
题干到底在问什么？注意点是什么？
原文如何定位？依据是什么？原文什么意思？什么逻辑？
正确选项如何对应原文？
错误选项改变了什么？
