第一篇消费升级类模板文章
一、核心生词详解
首段
1. priority
- 音标：/praɪˈɒrəti/
- 词性：n.（名词）
- 常见释义：优先事项；优先权；优先次序
- 文中含义：（选择餐厅时的）优先考虑因素
- 补充：复数形式为priorities
2. prominent
- 音标：/ˈprɒmɪnənt/
- 词性：adj.（形容词）
- 常见释义：显著的；突出的；杰出的；重要的
- 文中含义：显著的、突出的
3. distinctive
- 音标：/dɪˈstɪŋktɪv/
- 常见释义：有特色的；与众不同的；独特的
- 文中含义：有特色的、独特的
- 补充：文中distinctive features 整体译为“特色”
核心段
4. phenomenon
- 音标：/fəˈnɒmɪnən/
- 常见释义：现象；奇迹；杰出的人
- 文中含义：现象
- 补充：复数形式为不规则变化phenomena
5. interconnected
- 音标：/ˌɪntəkəˈnektɪd/
- 词性：adj.（形容词）/ 动词过去分词
- 常见释义：相互关联的；相互连接的
- 文中含义：相互关联的
- 词根：inter-（相互）+ connect（连接）+ -ed
6. reshape
- 音标：/ˌriːˈʃeɪp/
- 词性：v.（动词）
- 常见释义：重塑；改造；重新塑造
- 文中含义：重塑、改变（格局）
- 词根：re-（重新）+ shape（塑造）
7. catering
- 音标：/ˈkeɪtərɪŋ/
- 常见释义：餐饮服务；承办酒席
- 文中含义：餐饮（行业）
- 补充：catering landscape 餐饮行业格局
8. landscape
- 音标：/ˈlændskeɪp/
- 常见释义：风景；景色；景观
- 文中含义：（行业/社会的）格局、态势
- 补充：熟词僻义，常用于宏观语境，如economic landscape 经济格局
9. structural
- 音标：/ˈstrʌktʃərəl/
- 常见释义：结构的；结构性的
- 文中含义：结构性的
- 搭配：structural shift 结构性转变
10. perceive
- 音标：/pəˈsiːv/
- 常见释义：感知；察觉；认为；看待
- 文中含义：看待、认知
11. overwhelmingly
- 音标：/ˌəʊvəˈwelmɪŋli/
- 词性：adv.（副词）
- 常见释义：压倒性地；绝大多数地
- 文中含义：在极大程度上
12. calculus
- 音标：/ˈkælkjələs/
- 常见释义：微积分；结石
- 文中含义：（决策的）考量逻辑、权衡标准
- 补充：熟词僻义，在经济/社会语境中表示决策时的算计与判断逻辑等
13. upend
- 音标：/ʌpˈend/
- 常见释义：颠倒；倒放；颠覆
- 文中含义：颠覆、彻底改变
14. sophisticated
- 音标：/səˈfɪstɪkeɪtɪd/
- 常见释义：复杂的；精密的；成熟老练的
- 文中含义：成熟的、进阶的
- 搭配：sophisticated mindset 成熟的观念
15. mindset
- 音标：/ˈmaɪndset/
- 常见释义：心态；思维模式；观念
- 文中含义：消费理念、思维观念
16. culinary
- 音标：/ˈkʌlɪnəri/
- 常见释义：烹饪的；厨房的
- 文中含义：烹饪的
- 搭配：culinary concepts 烹饪理念
17. attentive
- 音标：英/əˈtentɪv/，美/əˈtentɪv/
- 常见释义：体贴的；周到的；专心的
- 文中含义：周到的、贴心的
- 搭配：attentive service 周到的服务
18. diner
- 音标：英/ˈdaɪnə(r)/，美/ˈdaɪnər/
- 常见释义：用餐者；食客；小餐馆
- 文中含义：食客、用餐者
19. captivating
- 音标：/ˈkæptɪveɪtɪŋ/
- 常见释义：迷人的；有吸引力的
- 文中含义：迷人的、有氛围感的
- 词根：动词captivate 迷住、吸引
20. embark
- 音标：/ɪmˈbɑːk/
- 常见释义：上船/飞机；着手；开始从事
- 文中含义：开启、着手推进
- 固定搭配：embark on/upon sth 开启某事
21. agenda
- 音标：/əˈdʒendə/
- 常见释义：议程；日程表
- 文中含义：工作重点、议事日程
- 搭配：top of the agenda 首要议程
22. targeted
- 音标：/ˈtɑːɡɪtɪd/
- 常见释义：定向的；针对性的
- 文中含义：针对性的、定向的
- 搭配：targeted measures 针对性措施
23. foster
- 音标：/ˈfɒstə(r)/
- 常见释义：促进；培育；培养；收养
- 文中含义：培育、提振
24. vibrant
- 音标：/ˈvaɪbrənt/
- 常见释义：充满活力的；鲜艳的
- 文中含义：有活力的、繁荣的
25. incentive
- 音标：/ɪnˈsentɪv/
- 常见释义：激励；奖励；动力
- 文中含义：激励、利好动力
26. differentiation
- 音标：/ˌdɪfəˌrenʃiˈeɪʃn/
- 常见释义：差异化；区别；分化
- 文中含义：差异化
- 词根：动词differentiate 区分、使差异化
27. subsidy
- 音标：/ˈsʌbsədi/
- 常见释义：补贴；补助金；津贴
- 文中含义：政策补贴
- 补充：复数形式为subsidies
结尾段
28. demonstrate
- 音标：/ˈdemənstreɪt/
- 常见释义：证明；表明；展示；演示
- 文中含义：表明、说明
29. precedence
- 音标：/ˈpresɪdəns/
- 常见释义：优先；优先权；领先地位
- 文中含义：优先地位、更高的重要性
- 固定搭配：take precedence over 优先于、比…更重要
30. propel
- 音标：/prəˈpel/
- 常见释义：推动；推进；驱使
- 文中含义：推动、助力
31. anchor
- 音标：英/ˈæŋkə(r)/
- 词性：v.（动词）/ n.（名词）
- 常见释义：n. 锚；支柱v. 锚定；扎根
- 文中含义：以…为根基、锚定
- 搭配：be anchored in 扎根于、以…为支撑
---
二、重点短语搭配
1. account for：（在数量、比例上）占；解释说明。文中用于描述占比，是图表写作高频短语。
2. followed closely by：紧随其后的是
3. revolve around：以…为中心；围绕…展开
4. consumption upgrade：消费升级
5. soak up：沉浸感受；吸收。文中表示“沉浸在氛围中”
6. embark on：着手；开启（重大事项）
7. expand domestic demand：扩大内需
8. service sector：服务业；服务行业。
9. rise to the top of the agenda：上升为首要议程、成为工作重点
10. roll out：推出（政策、产品、方案）；铺开
11. market differentiation：市场差异化
12. customer traffic：客流量；到店客流
13. take precedence over：优先于；比…更重要
14. consumption-led growth model：消费主导型增长模式
三、关键语法点解析（基础差同学可不看，对背诵和套写没有任何影响）
1. 介词+which 引导的非限制性定语从句
- 原文例句：...the result of a survey, in which consumers ...
- 解析：修饰先行词survey，还原为普通句是Consumers were asked... in the survey。将介词in 提前到关系
代词which 前，是正式写作中让句式更紧凑的高频写法。
2. 过去分词短语作伴随状语
- 原文例句：...followed closely by service quality at 27.4%
- 解析：过去分词短语作伴随状语，逻辑主语是前半句的整体内容，相当于and it is followed closely by...，
可以简化句子结构，避免重复使用并列句。
3. 现在分词短语作后置定语
- 原文例句：two interconnected forces, reshaping China’s catering landscape
- 解析：现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰前面的two interconnected forces，相当于定语从句which are
reshaping...
被修饰词与分词是主动关系，表示“正在重塑行业格局的两股力量”。
4. as 引导的时间状语从句
- 原文例句：as China embarks on ...
- 解析：as 此处意为“随着”，引导时间状语从句，强调主从句动作同步推进。
5. 过去分词短语作后置定语（anchored in）
- 原文例句：... growth model, anchored in quality and value
- 解析：anchored in... 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰growth model，相当于which is anchored in...。固
定搭配be anchored in 作定语时省略be 动词，直接用分词形式，意为“以…为根基的”。
第二篇个人品质类模板文章
1. ascent
- 音标：/əˈsent/
- 常见释义：上升；升高；上坡路；攀登

- 音标：/ˈvɪzəbli/

- 音标：/fəˈtiːɡd/
- 常见释义：疲惫的；精疲力竭的
- 文中含义：疲惫不堪的
- 补充：名词形式为fatigue（疲劳、劳累）
4. microcosm
- 音标：/ˈmaɪkrəʊkɒzəm/
- 常见释义：微观世界；缩影

6. tension
- 音标：/ˈtenʃn/
- 常见释义：紧张；张力；矛盾对立
- 文中含义：矛盾、对立关系
7. seductive
- 音标：/sɪˈdʌktɪv/

8. retreat
- 音标：/rɪˈtriːt/

9. unwavering
- 音标：/ʌnˈweɪvərɪŋ/

- 文中含义：坚定不移的
- 补充：词根waver 意为“动摇、犹豫”，un- 为否定前缀
10. perseverance
- 音标：/ˌpɜːsəˈvɪərəns/

- 文中含义：坚韧不拔的精神、坚持
11. embody
- 音标：/ɪmˈbɒdi/

12. seemingly
- 音标：/ˈsiːmɪŋli/

- 文中含义：看似、表面上
13. insurmountable
- 音标：/ˌɪnsəˈmaʊntəbl/
- 常见释义：不可逾越的；无法克服的
- 文中含义：难以跨越的、无法战胜的
- 补充：词根surmount 意为“克服、越过”，in- 为否定前缀
14. personify
- 音标：/pəˈsɒnɪfaɪ/
- 常见释义：拟人化；是…的化身
- 文中含义：是…的具象代表、化身
15. warring
- 音标：/ˈwɔːrɪŋ/
- 常见释义：交战的；敌对的；相互冲突的
- 文中含义：彼此矛盾的、相互拉扯的
16. instinct
- 音标：/ˈɪnstɪŋkt/

17. halfway

20. persistence
- 音标：/pəˈsɪstəns/
- 常见释义：坚持；持续；毅力
- 文中含义：持之以恒、坚持
21. resilient
- 音标：/rɪˈzɪliənt/
- 常见释义：有弹性的；适应力强的；能复原的
- 文中含义：有抗挫韧性的

1. 地点状语前置的完全倒装句
- 原文：In the picture above are two climbers ....
- 解析：正常语序为Two climbers are in the picture above。当表示地点的介词短语置于句首，谓语为be 动词
/不及物动词（stand, lie, come 等），且主语是名词时，句子使用完全倒装，将谓语提到主语前。这是图画作
文开篇，比正常语序更有画面感。
2. 形容词短语作插入语
- 原文：One climber, visibly fatigued, expresses his desire to quit.
- 解析：visibly fatigued 是形容词短语作插入语，相当于非限制性定语从句who is visibly fatigued，补充说明
主语的状态。插入语前后用逗号隔开，可丰富句子信息层次，避免句式单调。
3. whether...or... 不定式结构作同位语
- 原文：the warring instincts within each of us, whether to ... , or to ...
- 解析：whether to do... or to do... 是并列不定式结构，作前面warring instincts 的同位语，具体解释两种矛
盾本能的内容。
5. 非限制性定语从句+比较状语从句嵌套
- 原文：Unlike ... instant gratification, which often vanishes as quickly as it appears
- 解析：which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰the fleeting high of instant gratification；从句内部又嵌套as quickly
as 引导的比较状语从句，表达“出现得有多快，消失得就有多快”。
6. not...but... 并列强调结构
- 原文：is achieved not in a single sprint, but in the quiet, uncelebrated moments of perseverance
- 解析：not...but... 意为“不是…而是…”，连接两个并列的介词短语，通过否定前者、肯定后者来强化核心
观点。
7. 过去分词短语作后置定语
- 原文：In an era defined by the allure of instant gratification
- 解析：defined by... 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰an era，相当于定语从句an era which is defined by...。
过去分词作定语可简化句子，避免重复使用定语从句，体现句式多样性。

1. What 引导主语从句的图表开篇结构
- 原文例句：What the above pie chart displays...
- 解析：`What the above pie chart displays` 是what 引导的主语从句，what 在从句中作displays 的宾语
(the above pie chart displays what)，整个从句作主句主语。
2. 介词+which 引导的非限制性定语从句
- 原文例句：a survey in which students from ....
- 解析：`in which` 引导非限制性定语从句修饰先行词survey，还原为完整陈述句是students were asked about
their purposes in the survey。
3. 现在分词作结果状语
- 原文例句：have also drastically improved the mobile learning experience, making in-depth, systematic learning
far more attainable
- 解析：`making...` 是现在分词短语作结果状语，表示前文动作带来的自然而然的结果，相当于非限制性定
语从句*which makes...*，可以避免句式重复，让逻辑更连贯。
4. more than 的递进语义用法
- 原文例句：The survey statistics offer more than a fleeting snapshot of students’ reading purposes
- 解析：more than 后接名词时，意为“不仅仅、不只是”，用于实现语义递进——先说明表层含义，再引出深
层本质，用于结尾段升华主题。

- 文中含义：充满活力的，动态发展的
37. renewal
- 音标：/rɪˈnjuːəl/
- 常见释义：更新，革新；恢复
- 文中含义：活化更新，传承创新
38. evolve
- 音标：/ɪˈvɒlv/
- 常见释义：演变，进化；逐步发展
- 文中含义：演进，发展
39. resonate
- 音标：/ˈrezəneɪt/
- 常见释义：回响；产生共鸣
- 文中含义：引发共鸣，代代相传
40. interconnected
- 常见释义：相互关联的，互联互通的
- 文中含义：互联互通的，联系紧密的
1. dragon boat race 龙舟赛
2. strain to do sth. 竭尽全力做某事
3. speed past 疾驰而过，飞速驶过
4. with emotion 感慨地，带着情绪
5. societal landscape 社会格局，社会面貌
6. instill sth. in sb. 向某人逐步灌输/培养某种品质
7. function as 起到…的作用，担当…的角色
8. social glue 社会粘合剂（比喻维系社会凝聚力的事物）
9. generational divide 代际隔阂
10. collective sense of belonging 集体归属感
11. cornerstone of social harmony 社会和谐的基石
12. nostalgic glance backward 对过往的怀旧回望
13.
far more than 远不止，不仅仅是
- 原文例句：In the picture above are an old couple ...
- 解析：正常语序为An old couple are standing along the riverside in the picture above. 当表示地点的介词短语
置于句首，谓语是be 动词或不及物动词（stand/lie/come 等），且主语为名词时，句子使用完全倒装，将谓语
动词提到主语前。
2. with 的复合结构（伴随状语）
- 原文例句：with the spectators cheering and waving
- 解析：结构为with + 宾语+ 现在分词作宾补，表示主句动作发生时伴随的状态。这里spectators 和
cheering/waving 是主动关系，因此用现在分词形式。
3. where 引导定语从句修饰抽象地点名词
- 原文例句：In an era where the relentless currents ...
- 解析：era（时代）属于抽象地点名词，用where 引导定语从句，相当于in which，表示“在这个时代中”。
正式写作中，类似的抽象名词还有stage, situation, case, point 等，都可以用where 引导定语从句。
4. 同位语从句
- 原文例句：a tangible affirmation that the rich tapestry of values and rituals will continue to thrive
- 解析：that 引导同位语从句，解释说明抽象名词affirmation 的具体内容。that 在从句中不充当任何成分，
只起连接作用，这是同位语从句与定语从句的核心区别。
5. not only 置于句首的部分倒装
- 原文例句：Not only does it bridge generational divides...
- 解析：当not only 放在句首时，所在分句需要使用部分倒装，即将助动词does 提前，实义动词bridge 用原
形。正常语序为It not only bridges generational divides... 。倒装句式可以强化语气，突出论证的层次感。
6. 现在分词作结果状语
- 原文例句：thereby nurturing a more inclusive character
- 解析：现在分词短语放在句末，前面的整件事是动作的发出者，表示前文动作带来的自然而然的结果，相
当于which thereby nurtures... 。可以替代并列句或定语从句，让逻辑更紧凑，句式更简洁高级。

常见带介词的to 短语归纳
在英语学习中，同学们常常会遇见许多含有to 的短语，而其中有些短语所含的to 为介词，它的后面
要求接名词，代词或动名词形式。往往容易将这种情况与不定式符号后接动词原形相混淆，为了帮助大家
区别记忆，现将常见介词带to 的短语归纳如下：

（比较：be particular about 对……过于讲究；挑剔）
be subject to 服从；隶属；易遭\受\患
be familiar to 为
……熟悉
be similar to 和……相似
be open to 对……开放
be loyal to
对……忠诚
be helpful to 对……有益处
be useful to 对……有用
be good to sb 对某人好
（比较：be good for 对……有益处）be bad to 对……不好be bad for（比较：对……有害
处）
be new to 对……不习惯；对……陌生
next to（否定词前）几乎；next to ……的旁边
due to 由于；归因于……
be due to do sth.预定要做某事
owing to 由于；因……的缘故
thanks to 多亏了；由于
as to 关于；至于
in/with regard to 关于
in/with relation to 关于；就……而论
according to 根据
subject to 在……条件下；依照
专项练习：
1. The engine of the plane was out of order and the thunderstorm ______ the helplessness of the
pilot in the sky. A. added to
B. made up
C.led to
D. took over
2. –-What a large and bright room! Is it a classroom?
---No. It ______ the students’ reading—room.
A. refers to
B. stands for
C. is meant for
D. makes up of
3. It was foolish of him to _______ his notes during that important test, and as a result, he got
punished.
A. stick to
B. refer to
C. keep to
D. point to
4.Eating too much fat can _______ heart disease and cause high blood pressure.
A. result from
B. devote to
C. attend to
D. contribute to
Keys:
1. A
2. C
3. B
4. D

英文中常用否定前缀总结
anti-表示，相反的，相对的antibody 抗体
non-表示“非”nonhuman 非人类
英语中大部分否定前缀构词法：
1> dis
加在形容词前
-- agreeable（adj.使人愉快的）
disagreeable（adj.不愉快的）
-- content（adj.满意的vt.使满足）
discontent（adj.不满的vt.令人不满n.不满）
-- graceful（adj.优美的）
disgraceful（adj.使失体面的, 耻辱的）
-- honest（adj.诚实的, 正直的）
dishonest（adj.不诚实的）
-- satisfactory（adj.满意的）
dissatisfactory（adj.不满意的）
加在名词前
-- agreement（n.同意）
disagreement（n.意见不同）
-- honesty（n.诚实, 正直）
dishonesty（n.不诚实, 不老实）
-- ability（n.能力, 才干）
disability（n.无力, 无能）
-- grace（n.优美, 雅致）
disgrace（n.耻辱）
-- comfort（n.舒适vt.安慰）
discomfort（n.不舒适vt.使不舒适）
可以加在动词前
-- agree（v.同意）
disagree（v.不同意）
-- appear（vi.出现）
disappear（vi.消失, 不见）
-- believe（相信, 信任）
disbelieve（v.不信, 怀疑）
在名词前加dis 得到动词, 表示除去、解除。
-- courage（n.勇气, 精神）
discourage（vt.使气馁）
-- root（n.根, 根部）
disroot / unroot（vt.连根拔除）
-- mask（n.面具, 掩饰v.戴面具, 掩饰）unmask / dismask（vt.揭露, 暴露）
-- burden（n.担子, 负担v.负担）
disburden（v.解除负担）
2>il -- 加在以i 开头的形容词之前
-- legal（adj.法律的, 法定的）
illegal（adj.违法的）
-- logical（adj.合乎逻辑的）
illogical（adj.不合逻辑的）
-- literate（adj.有文化的n.学者）
illiterate（adj.没受教育的n.文盲）
3>im -- 加在以b, m, p 开头的形容词之前
-- possible（adj.可能的）
impossible（adj.不可能的）
-- mortal（adj.必死的, 人类的）
immortal（adj.不朽的）
-- moral（adj.道德的）
immoral（adj.不道德的）
-- balanced（adj.平衡的）
imbalanced（adj.不平衡的）
-- balance
（n.平衡）

imbalance（n.不平衡）
2
4>ir -- 加在以r 开头的形容词之前
-- regular（adj.规则的）
irregular（adj.不规则的）
-- rational（adj.理性的）
irrational（adj.无理性的）
-- resistible（adj.可抵抗的）
irresistlble（adj.不可抵抗的）
5>in --主要用于其它字母开头的词之前
-- human（adj.人性的）
inhuman（adj.野蛮的）
-- correct（adj.正确的）
incorrect（adj.不正确的）
-- justice（n.正义, 公平）
injustice（n.不正义, 不公平）
-- sincere（adj.真诚的）
insincere（adj.虚假的, 不真诚的）
6>un --只能用于形容词和动词之前
不-- happy（adj.快乐的）
unhappy（adj.不幸的, 不快乐的）
-- friendly（adj.友好的）
unfriendly（adj.不友好的）
-- lucky（adj.幸运的）
unlucky（adj.不幸的）
无-- conditional（adj.有条件的）
unconditional（adj.无条件的）
-- limited（adj.有限的）
unlimited（adj.无限的）
非-- official（adj.官方的, 正式的）
unofficial（adj.非官方的, 非正
式的）
-- just（adj.正义的, 公正的）
unjust（adj.不公平的）
未（主要用于过去分词之前）
-- undecided（adj.未定的）
unfinished（adj.未完成的）
-- unexpected（adj.未预料到）
unhurt（adj.没有受伤的）
用于动词之前表示做相反的动作
-- lock（v.锁, 锁上）
unlock（vt.开...锁）
-- tie（vt.系, 打结）
untie（vi.松开, 解开）
-- cover（vt.覆盖）
uncover（vt.揭开, 揭露）
-- pack（vt.包装）
unpack（v.打开包裹）
-- dress（v.穿衣）
undress（vt.使脱衣服）
-- load（v.装载）
unload（v.卸货）
Exercise：
1> polite（adj.有礼貌的）
impolite（adj.无礼的, 粗鲁的）
2> agree
disagree
3> legible（adj.清晰的, 易读的）
illegible（adj.难辨认的, 字迹模糊
的）
4> accurate（adj.正确的, 精确的）
inaccurate（adj.错误的, 不准确的）
5> locked
unlocked
6> regular
irregular

  考研英语在2010年以前不分英语一和英语二，统称考研英语，所以表中2010年以前的年
份没有分英语一、英语二。须注意的是，从考研英语改革元年—2005年开始，直至2009年，
考研英语试题和现在的英语一极为接近，所以本书中无论是大作文还是小作文，都是从2005
年真题开始讲解的。

（1） 慈善公益类话题考点群
慈善公益类话题有2006 年真题、2019 年英语一真题、2013 年英语二真题。
2006 年真题
Directions:
You want to contribute to Project Hope by offering financial aid to a child in a
remote area. Write a letter to the department concerned, asking them to help find a
candidate. You should specify what kind of child you want to help and how you will
carry out your plan.
Write your letter with no less than 100 words. Write it neatly on ANSWER
SHEET 2.
Do not sign your name at the end of the letter; use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)
【范文】 —— 运用（3）咨询信模板
Dear Madam or Sir,
I am a person willing to make regular donations through Project Hope. I am
writing this letter to see whether it is possible for you to provide me with some
information regarding the specific candidate.
In the first place, I hope you can select a girl who is under ten years old from
remote communities in the northwest part of China. Then, I will sponsor her by
paying the corresponding tuition fees until she finishes the courses in university.
Finally, I would like to offer the child appropriate books in order to encourage
reading from now on.
I will appreciate it if you pay prompt attention to this letter. Thank you for your
time and consideration. Looking forward to your reply. (125 words)
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

孩。然后，我将资助她相应的学费，直到她大学毕业。最后，我还愿意为她提

Suppose you are working for the “Aiding Rural Primary Schools” project of
your university. Write an email to answer the inquiry from an international student
volunteer, specifying the details of the project.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Don’t use your own name. Use “Li Ming” instead. (10 points)
【范文】 ——运用（4）建议信模板
Dear Tom,
Thank you for your inquiry regarding the “Aiding Rural Primary Schools”
project. I am writing this letter for the purpose of providing you with some
information about the overall arrangements. The relevant details are as follows.
First of all , we will organize a charity sale in the Students’ Auditorium on
December 26, 2021. And the money from the sale will be used to pay for the tuition
fees of the primary school students. Secondly, this fund-raising activity will last one
month and our university is accepting applications for part-time volunteers who have
three working days during the event.
I would be more than happy if the above points would answer your questions at this
stage. And if you need any further information, please feel free to contact me. （130 words）

2013 年英语二真题
Suppose your class is to hold a charity sale for kids in need of help. Write your
classmates an email to
1) inform them about the details, and  2) encourage them to participate.
Do not use your own name; use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not write your address. (10 points)
【范文】 —— 运用（10）倡议信模板
Dear Classmates,
We will organize a charity sale in the Students’ Auditorium on December 26,
2021. On behalf of the Student Union, I am calling on all of you to take part in it.
We hope you can offer your second-hand goods that are available at bargain
prices and all the proceeds will go to supporting the poor children’s tuition fees. In
addition, this fund-raising activity will last three days so that everyone can catch
this opportunity to give a hand. The reason why we should do this is that these young
kids in the disadvantaged communities really need financial assistance to finish
school and continue further education.
As students of ABC University, we ought to endeavor to help these children and
make the world a fairer place. (132 words)

我们将于2021 年12 月26 日在学生会堂组织一次慈善义卖。我代表学生
会呼吁大家参加。
我们希望大家能以便宜的价格出售你们的二手商品，所有收益将用于支付
贫困地区孩子们的学费。 此外，这项筹款活动将持续三天，这样每个人都有机
会伸出援手。我们之所以这样做，是因为那些身处贫困地区的孩子们确实需要
资金援助才能完成学业并继续深造。
作为ABC 大学的学生，我们应该努力帮助这些孩子，以让世界变得更加公平。
（2） 图书馆类话题考点群
图书馆类话题有2007 年真题、2016 年英语一真题。
2007 年真题
Write a letter to your university library, making suggestions for improving its service.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead.
【范文】 —— 运用（4）建议信模板
I am Li Ming, a student of our university. I am writing this letter for the purpose
of providing you with some suggestions about the service that our library provides.
The relevant details are as follows.
First of all, could you please prolong the opening time for public study areas
during examinations? And, personally, I think a 2-hour extension to 11:00 p.m.
would be great. Secondly, there are so many students rushing to the self-study room
that it is usually overloaded. So I hope that the study area can be enlarged. Last but
not least, the journals need to be replaced by the latest ones in time.
I would be more than happy if you take my suggestions into serious account.
Looking forward to your reply. (132 words)
114
我是本校的学生李明，我写这封信是就图书馆服务提出一些建议。相关的
细节如下。
首先，请问能否在考试期间延长自习区的开放时间？我个人认为能延长两
小时, 到晚上11 点就好了。其次，有太多的学生去自习室，通常情况下自习室
是超负荷的，因此我希望扩大学习区域。最后，图书馆的期刊需要及时更新。
如果您认真考虑我的建议，我会非常高兴。期待您的回复。
2016 年英语一真题
Suppose you are a librarian in your university． Write a notice of about 100
words, providing the newly-enrolled international students with relevant information
about the library．
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET．
Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice． Use “Li Ming” instead．
Do not write the address． (10 points)
【范文】 ——运用告示模板
NOTICE
December 26, 2021
Welcome to China and congratulations on your admission to ABC University.
This notice is to inform all the newly-enrolled international students of the detailed
information about the university’s library.
In the first place, we have prolonged the opening time for public study area
during examination, which is 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. But the service desk closes
at 6:00 p.m. during semester and the exam period. Secondly, the library is located
in the northwest corner of the campus and there is a free coffee shop on the ground
floor. Finally, the reading area was enlarged by us a week ago and the  journals have
already been replaced by the latest ones.
If you need any further information, please feel free to contact us. (124 words)

You are supposed to write for the Postgraduate Association a notice to recruit volunteers
for an international conference on globalization. The notice should  include the basic
qualification for applicants and the other information which you think is relevant.
You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of
the notice. Use “Postgraduate Association” instead.
【范文】 —— 运用告示模板
This notice is to inform all the students that an international conference on
globalization will be organized by the Postgraduate Association from January 2 to
January 9 and volunteers are needed.
In the first place, this meeting will seek to shine a light on a wealth of issues that
are fundamental to economic development and progress across the globe. Secondly,
the conference will last for a week and our university is accepting applications for part-
time volunteers who have three available working days during this event. Finally,
students are asked to drop off their resumes with a cover letter at the Education Office
and the outstanding candidates will get informed soon. (111 words)
Postgraduate Association

（4） 推荐类话题考点群
推荐类话题有2011 年英语一真题、2015 年英语一真题。
2011 年英语一真题
Write a letter to a friend of yours to  1) recommend one of your favorite
movies and  2) give reasons for your recommendation.
【范文】 ——运用（7）推荐信模板
I am writing this letter for the purpose of recommending a movie which is
called The Last Emperor. And the reasons why I pick this film are as follows.
First of all, the movie displays the grandeur of the Great Wall and the
Forbidden City. So you can get a better understanding of Chinese culture through
these two greatest ancient architectural miracles. Additionally, this film is an epic
biographical drama which introduces Chinese history of the Qing Dynasty and
Puyi’s life as a political prisoner and war criminal.
Hope you will like the plots that I mentioned. And I am looking forward to
discussing more with you. (118 words)

Some international students are coming to your university. Write them an email

providing you with some suggestions about your new life in college. The relevant
details are as follows.
First of all, I would like to suggest you manage your time wisely with precise
plans. Secondly, sticking to the routine of studying in the library and exercising
in the gym will ensure you a balanced university life. Last but not least, the
best advice for you is to not only concentrate on your studies but also spend time
socializing with other students of various cultures.
For further information, please feel free to contact us. (134 words)

Suppose your cousin Li Ming has just been admitted to a university. Write him/
her a letter to
1) congratulate him/her, and
2) give him/her suggestions on how to get prepared for university life.

【范文】 ——运用（9）祝贺信模板
Dear Li Ming,
I am so glad to hear that you have secured admission to ABC University, one of
the best universities in our country. Congratulations! You do not know how excited
and happy we felt when we heard this news.
It is your own intelligence and diligence that have earned you this achievement.
And I’m sure you will continue making constant improvements in your academic
work in the university. I believe you will get greater success in the further
development. Meanwhile, I would like to suggest you manage your time wisely
with precise plans. In addition, sticking to the routine of studying in the library and
exercising in the gym will ensure you a balanced university life.
Again, congratulations and best wishes for further success. (126 words)
Zhang Wei

于我们新的远程学习系统的简短演示。最后，我们希望你能完成一份在线问
卷，其中涉及对在线课程的态度以及能够帮助改进系统的任何建议。
请告诉我你是否可以接受我们的邀请。期待你的回复。

（9） 环境保护类话题考点群
2009 年真题
Restrictions on the use of plastic bags have not been so successful in some
regions. “White Pollution” is still going on.
Write a letter to the editor(s) of your local newspaper to
1) give your opinions briefly, and
2) make two or three suggestions.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead.
Dear Editors,
I am a person paying close attention to environmental problems. I am writing
this letter for the purpose of providing you with some suggestions about limiting the
use of plastic bags. The relevant details are as follows.
First of all , every resident is expected to remould their attitudes towards the
white pollution and assume the responsibility to preserve our environment owing to
the fact that plastic bags cannot be degraded. Hence, some science articles on the
detrimental effects of white pollution can be published in your newspaper to inform
the public of the seriousness of the issue. Secondly, it is a good way to set many
131
designated recycling spots in our city, which will help re-use and reduce the waste of
plastic bags to a large extent.
Looking forward to your reply. (149 words)
尊敬的编辑们：
一些建议。相关的细节如下。
第一，由于塑料袋不能降解，每个居民都应该重新看待白色污染，并承
担保护环境的责任。因此，贵刊可以刊登一些关于白色污染有害性的科普文
章，让公众了解问题的严重性。第二，在我们的城市里设置指定回收点是减轻
白色污染的好方法，这将有助于塑料袋的循环使用，在很大程度上减少塑料袋
的浪费。
2011 年英语一大作文尾段（见背诵手册环境类模板替换段）
In order to cope with this imperative issue, joint efforts should be made by the
government, press, enterprises and other concerned departments to curb the further
environmental deterioration. More importantly, every individual, especially the
visitors, is expected to remould their attitudes towards the environment and assume
the responsibility to preserve it.
为处理这一紧急问题，政府、媒体、企业和其他相关部门应共同努力抑制
环境的继续恶化。更重要的是，每一个人，尤其是游客们，应该重新看待环境
并且承担起保护环境的责任。

5.5.4.2  尚未重复考查过的真题
建议大家把以下这些年份的真题范文全文背诵。因为真题有重复考查的规

（1）尚未重复考查过的英语一真题（包含2005 年、2008 年、2014 年）
2005 年真题
Two months ago you got a job as an editor for the magazine Designs &
Fashions. But now you find that the work is not what you expected. You decide to
quit. Write a letter to your boss, Mr. Wang, telling him your decision, stating your
reason(s), and making an apology.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter; use “Li Ming” instead.
Do not need to write the address. (10 points)
【范文】 ——运用（1）辞职信模板
Dear Mr. Wang,
I am writing this letter because I intend to resign from my current position. The
reasons for my resignation are as follows.
To begin with, I often put 70 or more hours a week into the company because
of the heavy workloads and I find it difficult to maintain a normal social life. In
addition, I live too far from the workplace, so the long commute often affects my
life with high travel costs. Finally, I want to focus more on the field that I chose in
college.
I am very grateful for the invaluable experience that I got here. Thank you for
the patience and assistance you rendered me during these months. Please accept my
sincere apologies for any inconvenience my leaving may cause. (128 words)
133
尊敬的王先生：
我写这封信是想辞职。辞职的原因如下。
首先，由于工作繁忙，我经常每周在公司工作70 多个小时，很难维持正常
的社交生活。其次，我住的地方离工作地点太远，所以过长的通勤时间往往会
影响我的生活，交通费用也很高。最后，我想更加专注于我本科所学的专业。
我非常感激我在这里获得的宝贵经验。感谢您这几个月对我的耐心和帮
助。对于我的离开可能带来的不便，请接受我诚挚的歉意。
2008 年真题
You have just come back from Canada and found a music CD in your luggage
that you forgot to return to Bob, your landlord there. Write him a letter to
1) make an apology, and
2) suggest a solution.
【范文】 ——运用（2）道歉信模板
Dear Bob,
I am writing this letter for the purpose of expressing my sincere apology for the
fact that I took your CD to my home by mistake.
I am sorry for taking your CD wrongly. Due to the fear of missing the flight, I
packed my luggage in a hurry. This is the reason why I did not realize your CD was
in my bag. To solve this problem, I will deliver the CD back to you by Express Mail
or I can order a new one for you from Amazon.
Once again, I feel really sorry for any inconvenience I have caused. I humbly
ask for your forgiveness and hope you could understand my situation. (117 words)

李，这就是我没有意识到你的CD 放在我的包里的原因。为解决这个问题，我

我再次对给你造成的不便表示歉意。衷心希望你能谅解我，并理解我的情况。

考研英语原创高分作文模板教程——讲解手册
（9）2025 年英一真题（创新手工艺展示活动）套写示范
Directions:
Read the following email from your classmate Paul and write him reply.
Dear Li Ming,
I was really excited to hear that you’d invite some young craftsmen to demonstrate
their innovative craft-making on campus. May I know more about what they’ll show?
Also, I’d like to help with your presentation work! Please let me know what I can do.
Yours,
Paul
Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name in the email; use “Li Ming instead. (10 points)
【套写示范】
Dear Paul,
I cordially invite you to attend the innovative craft-making show, which will be held at
the Students’ Auditorium from 3 pm to 5 pm on January 15, 2026.
More than a meaningful event, the display is designed to provide a unique networking
platform for international students and local students. There will be AI-powered tie-dye and
virtual simulation of lacquer art display. Can you help me download some papers on these
crafts from the university’s official website?
Finally, there is no dress code requirement for this event. Please get in touch with me on
or before January 5 to confirm your attendance. I look forward to seeing you. (114 words)
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
【中文译文】
亲爱的保罗：
我诚挚地邀请你前来参加中国传统手工艺展示活动，这个活动将于2026 年1 月15
日下午3 点至5 点在学生礼堂举行。
这场展示不仅仅是一次有意义的活动，更是旨在为留学生和本地学生提供一个独特
的交流平台。届时将会有AI 扎染和虚拟仿真漆艺展示。你能帮我在学校官网上下载一些
关于这些工艺的论文吗？
最后，本次活动没有着装要求。请在1 月5 日或之前与我联系以确认你是否参

你真诚的,

CHAPTER 9　组群组句与小作文策略
（7）2025 年英二真题（推荐电影）套写示范
Suppose you are planning a short play based on a classic Chinese novel. Write your friend
John an email to
1) introduce the play, and     2) invite him to take part in it.
Do not sign your own name in your email; use “Li Ming” instead.
Dear John,
Hope you are doing well. I am writing with regard to your previous enquiries, in which
you asked me to recommend some projects related to Chinese imperial court culture. And I am
currently planning a short play centered around this theme.
I cordially invite you to take part in this play adapted from the classical Chinese novel
the Monumental Forbidden City. It tells that the palace is not only the royal residence of the
emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties but also the carriers of court society and traditional
etiquette. The play will feature a stunning scene: the Forbidden City is covered in snow and
elegantly decorated for the New Year. So I believe you will have an immersive performing
experience.
If you need any further information, please feel free to contact me. (138 words)
亲爱的约翰：
希望你一切都好。我写邮件是因为你上次询问我，让我推荐一些关于中国传统宫廷
文化的项目。而最近我正在策划一部关于宫廷文化的短剧。
我诚挚邀请你参演这部改编自中国古典小说《不朽的紫禁城》的短剧。小说讲述
了紫禁城不仅是明清两代的皇家居所，也是宫廷社会和传统礼仪的载体。短剧中将呈现
绝美场景：银装素裹的紫禁城为迎接新年张灯结彩，相信你将获得沉浸式的表演体验。
如果需要任何进一步的信息，请随时与我联系。

【27 考研】图表作文万能模板| 英一/二通用
27 考研作文模板新鲜出炉啦！英一&二通用，全面覆盖所有考纲题型（图画题、图表题和材料作文），并采用文
字中穿插图片、动图、音频和短视频的方式来增强呈现效果，帮助大家更好地理解和记忆~
鉴于去年英一、英二均考查了图表作文，本期先为大家讲解图表题的万能模板，涵盖内容：开篇引言、图表描
述、原因分析、趋势预测、建议与展望（若干平行模板句型+每个句型多个变体+真题例句），另附26 年英一&
英二真题范文。
首先来看一下几种常考的图表类型：
Column chart（柱状图）：用竖柱比较数据；
Bar chart（条形图）：用横条比较数据（通常用于名称较长的项目）；
Pie chart （饼状图）：展示各部分占整体的比例；
Line graph（折线图）：反映数据随时间的变化趋势；
Table（表格）：用行列呈现具体数据
一、开头段模板
1. 开篇引言
备选句型1）
The chart offers a/an (revealing/broader/informative) glimpse into...
该图表（富含启示/视角宽广/信息丰富），使我们洞察到……
注1：The chart 可替换为上文给出的相应图表名称，下同
注2：“/”表示平行选项，可择一记忆；（ ）中的选项为引导性内容，大家可自行变更，或者舍弃
注3：glimpse [ɡlɪmps]是窥见、瞥见的意思，glimpse into 意为“洞察到”，后面可接抽象的调查结果或见解
食
英语美食
na的英语美食
语美食
号/B站：Fiona的英语美食
公
2
例句：The pie chart offers a revealing glimpse into customers’ priorities when choosing a
restaurant in a particular city in 2017. （18 年真题：选择餐厅的因素）
备选句型2）
The chart sheds light on… / The chart (calls/draws/invites) attention to…
例句：The column chart (sheds light on / draws attention to) the changes in China’s urban and
rural populations from 1990 to 2010. （14 年真题：城乡人口变化）
备选句型3）
The chart presents (the results of a survey on… / a holistic picture of... / an informative overview of...
/ a comprehensive view of...)
该图表呈现出（一项关于……的调查结果/......的丰富信息/……的整体情况/……的综合图景）
注：Holistic [hoʊˈlɪstɪk] 整体的，全面的；informative [ɪnˈfɔːrmətɪv]：信息丰富，数据较多时适用该词
例句：The column chart presents a holistic picture of China’s parcel delivery trends in recent years.
（22 年英二真题：快递业务量增长）
该柱状图呈现出近几年中国快递业务的整体情况。
小结：
三个备选句型，择一记忆即可，其中句型1）兼具普适性与形象感；句型2）适合接较长的主题句；句型3），
尤其是the results of a survey on…这个填充项，最具易用性
3
2. 图表描述
引语：Specifically / As can be seen / It is clear that / To be specific / According to the data
语意上都可以理解为“具体而言”，可按需取用，比如Specifically 适合简洁文风，According to the data 适
合凑字数
静态图（含饼图、条形图，以及不带趋势的柱状图）：
高值：the (percentage/proportion) of…stands at…%
......百分数/百分比为...%
中值：followed (closely) by...
其次是……
低值：and only a small minority (…%）/ only a mere ...% prefer...
只有一小部分人（…%）/ 仅有…% 选择......
例句：According to the data, the percentage stands at 37% when it comes to the purpose of
traveling for sightseeing, followed by 33% for relaxation, and only a small minority travel to make
friends (9%), cultivate independence (6%), or for other purposes (15%). （16 年真题：大学生旅行目的）
具体来看，欣赏风景的人占比37%，其次，33%的人是为了放松，只有少数人旅游是为了交朋友（9%）、培养
独立能力（6%）或其他目的（15%）。
高值：... account(s) for / constitute(s) / make(s) up …of (all respondents / the total).
......占（受访者/总数）的...%
中值：This is followed by… / Following this, …
4
低值：By contrast, the proportion of… is (lower / relatively low / much lower), standing at …%
相比之下，……的比例（较低/相对较低/低得多），为……%
注1：如果By contrast 后面是两项数据，可以这样表述：By contrast, the proportions of… and… are lower, standing at …%
and …% respectively.
注2：当The number/percentage of…后面的名词过长时，可以把名词置后，改为The number/percentage stands at…for
sb/sth，或：The number/percentage stands at…when it comes to…
注3：stand at 后面既可以接数字也可以接百分数，而account for / constitute / make up 后面只能接百分数，另外百分号前
可以加形容词修饰，比如a substantial...% / a massive ...% / an impressive...% / an overwhelming…%
例句：As can be seen, students who acquired knowledge account for an impressive 91.30% of all
respondents. This is followed by 84.80% who reported an improvement in their hands-on skills. By
contrast, the proportions of students who felt emotionally refreshed and enhanced their
cooperation skills are lower, standing at 54.40% and 32.60% respectively. （24 年真题：劳动实践课收
获）
具体而言，91.30%的学生获得了知识，这个百分比令人印象深刻。其次，有84.80%的学生认为自己的动手能
力得到了提升。相比之下，感到心情舒畅和提升了合作能力的学生占比较少，分别为54.40%和32.60%。
动态图（含折线图、表格和带趋势的柱状图）：
a. 总体趋势：
an upward / a downward trend is visible in...
……有明显的上升趋势/下降趋势
a slowdown / an upturn is observed in…
……呈现放缓趋势/上升趋势
b. 数值变化：
5
In…, the number / percentage (of...) stands at..., which jumps to / falls to / rises (slightly) to / drops
(dramatically) to...
在（…年），……的数量/百分比为…… (跃升/跌落/缓慢上升/剧烈下降到....)
注1：时态需根据题意变化，呈现数据等客观内容时使用一般现在时，有年份的情况下使用过去时。
注2：倍数关系可以用如下表达：almost doubled / tripled / quadrupled 或which increases about fivefold / sixfold...；最
高/低点的表达：reaching an all-time high/low
例句：To be specific, (an upward trend is visible / an upturn is observed) in the nationwide volume
of parcel deliveries. In 2018, the number of parcels stood at 51 billion, which jumped to 83 billion in
2020. （22 年真题：快递业务量增长）
具体而言，我国包裹投递量有明显上升趋势。2018 年的包裹数量为510 亿件，2020 年跃升至830 亿件。
3. 双图过渡：
Meanwhile,
(the
right-hand
chart
/
the
on
right
below)
shows/indicates/suggests/reveals that...
同时，（右侧/下侧图表)显示……
例句：Meanwhile, the right-hand chart shows that the number of parks jumped from 406 to 670 in a
particular city between 2020 and 2022. （24 年英一真题：公园数量增长）
同时，右侧图表显示，在2020 年至2022 年期间，某市公园数量从406 座跃升至670 座。
When shifting/narrowing the focus to…, there is (also) a sharp increase / a slowdown in... (during
the same X-year period).
再来看/聚焦……，同期……（也）有强劲增长/下降
6
例句：When narrowing the focus to rural areas, there was also a sharp increase in parcel volume,
with the figure rising from 12 billion to 30 billion during the same three-year period. （22 年真题：快
递业务量增长）
再来聚焦农村地区，同期包裹量从120 亿，强势增长到300 亿。
二、中间段模板
1. 承上启下
Judging by the data/ Taking a holistic view, there is a significant expansion in… / a
(noticeable/robust) increase in... The reasons are twofold/threefold:
根据数据/整体来看，……出现显著扩张 /……有明显增长。原因有两点/三点：
注1：该句适合能够概括出一种主流现象/趋势的图表题
注2：threefold 后面可以用First, … Second, … Third, …展开；twofold 后面可以用For one thing, ... For another thing, …
注3：有些批改软件会指出前后主语不一致，也就是悬垂修饰的问题，但这里的主语是there，逻辑上不会是“Judging by the
data/ Taking a holistic view”的发出者，语意清晰，不会引发误解；这种结构是一种约定成俗的用法，在分析性文本中尤为常
见，语料库中例句颇丰；仍有顾虑的同学可以选择备选句型2）或3）
例句：Taking a holistic view, there is a significant expansion in the delivery business. The reasons are
threefold: First,… Second,… Third,…（22 年英二真题：快递业务量增长）
整体来看，快递业务出现了显著扩张。原因有三：第一……第二……第三……
In an up-close view/ Upon closer examination, two/three factors could provide more clarity on this
phenomenon/pattern/trend.
进一步来看/仔细审视，三个因素可以使我们更清楚地了解这一现象/情况/趋势。
7
Beneath the surface of these figures lie three major factors that may account for this
这些数据的表象之下，有三个主要因素可以解释这一现象/情况/趋势。
注：这个句子是倒装句，顺序语序是：Three major factors (that may account for this phenomenon/pattern/trend) lie
beneath the surface of these figures.
2. 原因分析
… (is no longer a major bottleneck / no longer poses a major barrier) to sth. This would translate
into…/ This naturally translates into…
……不再是……的主要瓶颈/障碍，这将转化为……
例句：Purchasing power (is no longer a major bottleneck / no longer poses a major barrier) to
consumption. This naturally translates into robust demand. （22 年真题：快递业务量变化）
购买力（不再是制约消费的主要瓶颈/障碍），这将转化为强劲的（消费）需求。
…is on track (for sth / to do sth). That is a big reason why… / That is a big part of the reason why…
……正朝着……目标前进，这是……的一个重要原因
例句：The country is on track for a strong economic performance that boosts overall prosperity.
That is a big part of the reason why more rural people to find a job in a city. （14 年真题：城乡人口变
化）
我国经济正走在强劲增长的轨道上，由此促进了整体繁荣，这是越来越多的农村人涌去城里找工作的一个重要
原因。
8
...has doubled down on (sth / doing sth). This may (help) explain why…
……已经加大力度（做某事），这有助于解释为什么……
注：doubled down 字面意思是“双倍下注”，引申为“加大力度”做某事
例句：The government has doubled down on promoting a supportive environment for
entrepreneurship. This may help explain why a growing number of graduates have chosen to start
their own businesses. （19 年真题：毕业生去向统计）
政府努力推动创业友好型环境的建设，这有助于解释为什么越来越多的毕业生选择自主创业。
备选句型4）
...has been gathering momentum/ ...is gaining momentum/…is riding the wave of (technological
innovation / digitalization / economic growth), thereby encouraging sth /sb to do sth
……势头强劲/……正乘着（科技创新/数字化/经济增长）的浪潮，从而促使……
注：encourage/discourage 字面意思是“鼓励/使泄气”，可引申为“促使/阻碍；有利于/不利于”的意思
例句：The development of robotics in China has been gathering momentum, thereby encouraging
more people to try such products. （2026 年真题：养老机器人）
中国的机器人产业发展势头日益强劲，从而吸引更多人尝试使用此类产品。
备选句型5）
(The convenience of / The availability of) …allows/enables sb to (access…)
（……的便利性/……的获得）使……能够……
例句：The convenience of websites and short-video platforms enables people to access health
information efficiently. （23 年真题：健康素养水平）
网站和短视频平台的便利性使人们能够高效地获取健康信息。

三、结尾段模板
1. 预测趋势
a. 引语：In the final analysis / As a final observation / In summary / To sum up / In conclusion / To
conclude
这些引语均表示“归根结底/总而言之”的意思，可择一记忆
b. 主干：we can probably expect to see (a persistent increase in / decline in / focus on...) (in the
foreseeable future / in the coming years).
（在可预见的未来/未来几年）我们很可能会看到（……持续增长/下降/保持......）
例句：
1. As a final observation, we can probably expect to see a persistent increase in the number of
graduates opting for further study and entrepreneurship. （19 年真题：毕业生去向统计）
总之，选择继续深造和创业的毕业生人数很可能会持续增长。
2. In the final analysis, we can probably expect to see a persistent focus on features as people dine
2. 行动建议
To make the most of... / For the potential of...to be unlocked, it is advisable / it would be
(wise/beneficial/preferable) for…to (stay focused on... / strike a delicate balance between...and...)
为了充分利用…… / 为了使（……的潜力 / 真正的创新）得到激发/释放，建议某人 / 对某人而言（明智/有益/更
好）的做法是，专注于…… / 在……和……之间取得很好的平衡
10
注：在四个备选建议句型中，这个句型最普适、最万能，而且可难可易、可盐可甜：单独用后半句可大幅降低应用难度，加上前
半句，可大幅提升语言质量
例句：For the potential of express industry to be unlocked, it is advisable for the government to
invest in expanded transportation networks. （22 年真题：快递业务量增长）
为了使快递行业的潜力得到释放，建议政府投资扩建运输网络。
Meanwhile/Accordingly, there is much room for…to (improve/promote…)
同时/相应地，……（在提升……）方面还有很大空间
注1：Meanwhile/Accordingly 并非该句专属，而是可以用于结尾段（甚至中间段）任意两个句子之间的衔接
注2：这个句式后面接的动词，一般是“发展、提升、改善”之类的抽象动词；不能是过于具体、一次性的动作，比如我们不能说
there is much room for us to plant trees
例句：Meanwhile, there is much room for cultural organizations to improve museum operations and
enhance the visitor experience.（17 年真题：博物馆参观人数）
与此同时，文化机构在改善博物馆运营和提升游客体验方面还有很大的空间。
Here's a suggestion for (the government / educational institutions / all parents): …
这是一条针对（相关机构/教育机构/所有父母）的建议：……
例句：Here's a suggestion for educational institutions: Provide supportive programs, such as career
counseling, to students as they approach graduation. （19 年真题：毕业生去向统计）
给教育机构的建议是：为即将毕业的学生提供支持性项目，比如职业咨询。
3. 展望未来
11
It may hold a particular promise of…
这样能最大限度地确保……
例句：It may hold a particular promise of a health-for-all society. （23 年真题：健康素养水平）
这样的举措尤其能够促成一个全民健康型社会的构建。
This is a reliable way to (ensure…)
这是（确保……）的可靠方法
例句：This is a reliable way to ensure a higher level of health literacy. （23 年真题：健康素养水平）
这是确保健康素养水平得到提升的可靠方法。
This is the best possible way to (achieve…)
这是（实现……）的最佳途径
例句：This is the best possible way to prepare college students for promising careers. （24 年真题：
劳动实践课收获）
这是使大学生能够做好准备，获得更好的职场发展的最佳途径。
真题范文
2026 年英一真题
12
范文：
The pie chart offers a revealing glimpse into people’ attitudes toward elderly-care robots. To be
specific, the percentage of consumers expressing full acceptance stands at 39.3%, followed by
partial acceptance at 32.8% and non-acceptance at 27.9%. Meanwhile, the right-hand chart shows
that, when purchasing elderly-care robots, consumers are more concerned about safety than about
price or convenience.
该饼图富含启示，展示了人们对养老机器人的态度。具体而言，表示完全接受的消费者占比为 39.3%，其次是
部分接受，占 32.8%，而不接受的比例为 27.9%。同时，右侧的图表显示，在购买养老机器人时，消费者对安
In an up-close view, three factors could provide more clarity on this pattern. First, the convenience
of elderly-care robots allows us to mitigate labor shortages in a fast-ageing society. Second, China's
robotics industry is riding the wave of technological innovation, thereby encouraging greater
consumer acceptance. Third, purchasing power is no longer a major bottleneck to consumption, as
the country is on track for strong economic performance. This may help explain why consumers
attach less importance to price than to safety.
13
深入来看，以下三个因素可以进一步解释这一现象。首先，在人口快速老龄化的社会中，养老机器人的便利性
有助于缓解劳动力短缺问题。其次，中国机器人产业正乘着科技创新的浪潮蓬勃发展，从而使消费者对养老机
器人的接受度进一步提高。第三，随着我国经济朝着强劲势头发展，购买力已不再是制约消费的主要瓶颈。这
或许可以解释为什么与安全性相比，消费者对价格的重视程度较低。
In the final analysis, we can probably expect to see an increasing number of people embracing
elderly-care robots. Accordingly, it is advisable for the government to stay focused on the quality of
robotic products to ensure safety. Such a move may hold a particular promise of navigating us into
an era of robots doing such work as elderly and medical care.
以确保其安全性。这样的举措有望使我们进入一个由机器人承担养老和医疗护理工作的时代。
2026 年英二真题
The column chart presents the results of a survey on the perceived benefits of outdoor activities for
14
children. Specifically, a substantial 54.6% believe that such activities can satisfy children’s curiosity,
followed closely by 54.5% who highlight their role in developing observation skills. By contrast, the
proportions of respondents who identify improved physical fitness and enhanced parent–child
interaction as benefits are lower, standing at 37.2% and 33.2% respectively.
该柱状图展示了一项关于儿童户外活动看法的调查结果。具体而言，多达 54.6% 的受访者认为，这类活动能够
满足儿童的好奇心；其次是 ，54.5% 的受访者认为户外活动在促进儿童观察力方面有很大作用。相比之下，将
强身健体和增强亲子互动视为户外活动益处的受访者比例相对较低，分别为 37.2% 和 33.2%。
Beneath the surface of these figures lie two major factors that may account for this pattern. First,
the availability of parks and natural spaces enables children to access diverse environments, thereby
satisfying their curiosity and sharpening their observation skills. Second, parents are more focused
on nature-based learning and exploration than on physical development, as modern education is on
track for a shift toward greater emphasis on children's cognitive development.
透过这些数据的表象，可以看到能够解释这一现象的两个主要因素。首先，公园和户外空间很多，儿童能够接
触到多种多样的环境，从而可以满足他们的好奇心，并促进观察力。其次，由于现代教育正逐渐重视儿童认知
In summary, to make the most of outdoor activities, it would be wise for parents to strike a delicate
balance between children’s cognitive development and physical fitness. This is a reliable way to
guide children toward realizing their full potential.
总之，为了充分发挥户外活动的作用，家长应当在孩子的认知发展和身体素质之间进行很好地协调。这样才能
更好地帮助孩子实现自身的最大潜能。

一、群文件相关问题
1. 模板使用方法
大作文：英一同学需要全面准备三种题型，英二同学重点准备图表，其他题型
量力而为，但建议至少构建一个基础的写作框架，有备无患。1）大家可以看群
文件2 中PDF，通过例句和范文熟悉模板用法，并借助文件6 中的思维导图进
行记忆，同一功能的模板句择一记忆即可，不需要把所有备选项都背下来~后
期还会陆续补充功能句和范文，供大家对照试写，形成自己的模板风格；2）有
余力的同学背诵范文中的通用句段（自选），用以辅助记忆模板句型，如果范
文中的模板句和自己选的句子不同，可以试着套用自己的选句，或额外背诵范
文选句；3）选背素材（文件6），主题契合的情况下，直接用素材无比畅爽。
小作文：看标号4 的群文件；如果时间紧张，可以只看标红的三期内容，然后
看思维导图中其他小作文类型的开头段和结尾段，各记一两个句子
大家的基本功和备考情况各不相同，上面建议仅供参考，大家可自行调整方案。
2. 群文件说明
文件1 是模板说明和重点问题的答疑汇总；
文件3 是b 站免费版大作文模板合集。免费版和付费版都是外刊句型，语言质
量和应用难度相当，只是免费版覆盖面有些局限，比如写材料分析类的论述文
和图表类的折线图或双图都比较欠缺。精力充沛的小伙伴可以双管齐下；追求
效率的同学可直接背付费版，后期还会给大家更新一份（付费版+免费版）结
合版全景思维导图，免费版的精华句型都会杂糅入内；
文件4 是b 站免费版小作文模板（当前有且仅有免费版~另外范文单独整合了
一个PDF）；
文件5 是高清思维导图（大作文+小作文+图画作文主题词）
文件6 是图画和材料作文的写作素材；包含了16 个常见话题的语段素材，有余
力的小伙伴可以选择性背诵，在情境契合的情况下，直接应用素材是最便利的
方法。一般情况下，中间段和结尾段任意位置均可用素材句代替原有的模板句，
比如：In a larger sense / Aside from that +素材句；
文件7 是去年版26 考研付费模板，供参考。
3. 群文件还会更新吗？
每3 周/更，至少更新六篇付费推文，群文件同步文字版PDF
4. 14-26 年的真题范文在哪里？
大家可以看文件2 中的PDF，每篇文末配有两篇范文；未更新的年份可以预先
参考文件7 中去年版本的范文合集
5. 如何积累常见的写作词汇和主题词？
可以看群文件6 中主题词的思维导图，可用于模板填空；另外，理论讲解部分
均配有b 站视频（可点击跳转）：图画题构词法；图表题构词法。
6. 大家都用同一套模板会不会雷同？
相比于名师模板，这个模板的受众很小，而且每个模板句都有若干备选项，大
家可以自由删减、拆分、组合，行文思路也可以多种变换，同时可以利用《主
题词》的各种变体填空，或使用群素材局部代替模板。另外，面对一个新的题
目，每个人对于模板的驾驭能力、施展招式和取舍方式都会有很大不同，反映
到卷面上有时会有天差地别。再加上同一个老师阅卷的可能性非常小，而且以
阅卷老师平均30 秒阅卷的记忆存留度，除非是前后相继的两份试卷，不然很难
发现两个人用了同一套模板；即使有所察觉，只要填空部分自然流畅， 我感觉
也没有什么问题~因为填空部分已经体现了你的功力
7. 有没有作文批改项目？
Up 能力有限，实在没有多余精力给小伙伴们一对一批改作文，建议使用扇贝、
Regrammar、ChatGPT 等AI 批改工具，如果想深度批改，可以在某宝找专业
老师或某薯找英专生~
8. 购买付费合集后还需要看b 站的视频课吗？
b 站视频课是免费模板的讲解，可以作为先导课程看一看，有助于理解付费模
板，并可以互为补充；如果时间和精力有限，可以直接看文件2 的付费模板
PDF，理论上付费模板覆盖免费模板的所有层面以及未有层面。
9. 付费模板有没有视频讲解？
每期推文里至少会穿插2 个短视频，讲解难点或重点内容
二、 付费模板相关问题
1. glimpse into 可以换成glimpse that 吗？
不可以~ glimpse that 后面的从句修饰的是glimpse 这个动作，不能表示
glimpse 窥见的内容
2. glimpse into 后面可以接doing 吗？
Glimpse into 后面可以接名词或疑问词引导的句子，不建议直接加doing，比
如a glimpse into making a right choice，翻译成中文是“窥见到了做出正
确选择”，有点似是而非的感觉，所以doing 前面最好加个the meaning of
之类的限定语，“窥见到了做出正确选择的意义”就没问题了。
3. 图画作文中的人物语言或者标题文字需要尽量原封不动地翻
译出来吗？
人物语言概括即可；如果用The caption below the picture reads: “…” 引
出标题文字，最好全部翻译，因为这句话意思就是：图片下方的文字是
“……”
4.  用疑问词引导的句子当主题词时，怎么把语序变成顺序？
我们一般只会用到what 和how 来引导主题词
如果是what，按主谓宾排序就可以，比如：what（主）+is（谓）+the right
attitude towards…（宾）；what（主）+keeps（谓）+us（宾）+going
（宾语补足语）
如果是how，那么how to+动词+宾语就可以了，比如how to make the
world better
5. Tapping into 有“鉴于”的意思吗？
“鉴于”是意译，tapping into 有“开发/利用”、“挖掘/探究”的意思，而
后者当于exploring into，比如Tapping Into Our Past, Tapping Into our
Future
(https://as.tufts.edu/fms/news-events/faculty-works/tapping-
our-past-tapping-our-future)
另外大家注意一点，tapping into the essence of... 最好不要填写过于具体的
内容，因为essence 这个词比较“大”，如果说tapping into the essence of
choosing classes，会有点awkward，但我们可以概括地说tapping into the
essence of making a choice ，或者说tapping into the essence of
education
6.  Tapping into…和后面的there is every reason to…主语
是否不一致？
两者的逻辑主语其实都是泛指的we ，大家可以参考这个语料库
一种句型结构：
7. “be poised to”可以表示倾向于吗？后面可以接消极做法
吗？
我在精华好句第九期（4 分22 秒开始） 讲解过Be poised to 的用法，其本意
是“摆好姿势，要做某事”的意思，可以表示“准备好了做某事”，并可引申为
“倾向于”，例如： Everything is poised to be something special. ——The
New York Times（万事万物都想与众不同——出自《纽约时报》）；如果后接
名词，可以用be poised for + n 的形式
“Be poised to”可以接消极做法，但要注意的是， Be poised to 是“摆出姿
势，要做某事”的意思，含有一种主动、愿意做某事的意味，所以其后接的负
面内容必须是“具有主动意愿/特别热衷”的情况，比如11 年的题目，我们就
不能说tourists are poised to throw rubbishes，因为游客只是下意识地随手
扔垃圾，并不是“特别愿意”去做这件事。对于非主动的情况，我们可以用
tend to 代替be poised to，或者可以变换说法：People are poised to make
an exploitation on natural resources, but ignore protecting our
environment. （这里说人们“特别热衷”于攫取自然资源就没有问题了）
8. 大作文各段字数应该怎样分布？
建议比例：(第一段) 3/4——（第二段） 5——（第三段） 2/3
其中3/4 是比例，占比3 或4，因为英一英二要求的字数不同，所以这里用比
例表示，行文过程中可以略作调整，比如建议句文思泉涌，第三段就可以写得
长一点
9. 图表作文分析原因时只聚焦某个最高数据可以吗？还是需要
综合论述呢？
中间段可以全盘分析，也可以挑选一二重点论述，或聚焦最高值或最低值展开
论述。
10. 图表内容需要全部描述吗？只说重点可以吗？
如果图表内容复杂，只说重点就可以了，首段字数最好不要超过中间段的字数
11. 图表第二段的原因阐述应该用什么时态？都用一般现在时
可以吗？
分析段一般都是客观论述，除了显然需要使用过去时的情况，建议都用现在时。
三、 小作文相关问题
1. 如果以个人名义写邀请信，开头段需要自我介绍吗？
我感觉自我介绍属于充分非必要条件，基本没有人会仅凭一封邮件，初次相识
就接受邀请，一般已对彼此线下身份有所了解或非常熟悉，但考试不需要完全
遵循实际情况，所以如果没有思路或字数不够，完全可以用自我介绍来做补
充。不过如果题目有明显暗示就需要自我介绍了，比如：请代表……邀请
2. 邀请信模板中的You are so welcomed to …是否有误？
welcome 为什么要变welcomed？
"You are welcome" 主要用作回应，例如，“Thank you”，“You are
welcome”，但这个短语通常不表达邀请或允许的意思。
"You are welcomed to" 通常用来表示邀请或允许某人做某事。例如，"You
are welcomed to join us for dinner" 。这个短语比较正式，通常用在邀请或
欢迎某人的情境中。
大家可以参考下面的语料库：
%AF%AD-%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87/are+welcomed+to
3. 邀请信中间段模板Prizes will be awarded against three
criteria 为什么是against？
“against”表示“比对”、“对照”，有一种衡量或比较的含义，如果改成
“for”，则是“为了三个标准而颁发奖品”，“with”也没有明确的衡量或比
较的含义，但用based on 或 according to 代替是可以的，只是相对静态，没
有against 这种“逐一对比”的动态感
4. 在使用模板句the event will be in three stages 时，开幕
式、嘉宾讲话、颁奖仪式要怎么表达呢？
开幕式：Opening Ceremony 嘉宾讲话：Guest Speech  颁奖仪式：Awards
Presentation
5. 建议信模板范文中the wider your reading habits, the
better for boosting your language skill. 为什么没有动词？
动词“are”和“it is”被省略了，完整的句子是：The wider your reading
habits are, the better it is for boosting your language skill.
6. 通知模板中(The event) is targeted to，批改软件总是给
改成targeted at ，需要改吗？be targeted to 和be
targeted at 用法一样吗？
Be targeted to 没有问题的，卫报和纽约时报都有例句：
具体来讲，“targeted to”和“targeted at”都可以表示“针对”或“以……
为目标”，区别是：to 侧重于描述目标对象或受众；at 侧重于指向目标或攻击
的对象，也就是指向性、针对性更强，如果说这项法律针对……，就更适合用
at 了，比如：Our legal powers are targeted at terrorists.
7. Please confirm your availability on or before xxx 这一
句中的on 和or 是什么用法呢？
on or before 是连在一起的，表示“在……日期或在……日期之前”
8. 小作文字数写多少合适呢？黄皮书上有的甚至都到了180 字
不建议写太多，100 词左右性价比最高，180 词至少要多占用15 分钟的时间，
即使小作文多得1、2 分，其他题目可能会丢掉5 分；而且字数多了不一定就高
分，要写得好才行，如果文采一般，180 词反而会让阅卷老师有抵触感

【图画作文】开头段怎么写（上）| 如何开篇
四个句型、一个句式，就能应对考研英语作文的开头段。先来看四个句型，均可以用作开篇
首句。
四个万能模板句型

2
句型说明
第一个句型的亮点是表示滴落、淌落的Drip 一词，而Drip with 可以很形象地表达“充满了
/传达出……”的意思。
第二个句型的Cast 可以产生聚光灯的形象感。
第三个句型有点文艺，适合温情或者寓意比较强的主题。
第四个句型是万能备胎，含金量不如前三个句型，但适用性极强。
我们以近十年的真题为例，用这四个句型一一攻破。
11 年题目：钓鱼与垃圾
The picture virtually drips with sarcasm when it comes to how we behave towards our
environment.
关于我们对待环境的行为，这张图片充满了讽刺。
12 年题目：乐观与悲观
3
The picture virtually drips with inspiration when it comes to how we perceive losses in
life.
关于我们如何看待生活中的得失，这张图片充满了启示。
或套用第二个句型：
The picture casts intense light on how we perceive losses in life.
13 年题目：毕业选择
The picture casts intense light on the confusion of college students while graduating.

这就是近10 年的题目，这四个句型360 度无死角全面覆盖。句四适用于所有题目，只是风
采不及前三，所以权当备用。
接下来就是描述图片内容了，下期给大家总结一个句式，用来拓展思路~
【图画作文】开头段怎么写（下）| 图片描述
上期给大家介绍了四个模板句型，用于开篇首句；今天再给大家总结一个句式，用于描述图
片内容。
一个句式
6
句式说明
首先我们可以用“It can be seen that”或“What emerges into our eyes is that”来接续
开篇首句，然后是sb does something，再用prep+n 进行延展，然后加上一个伴随状态的
从句，在从句的基础上还可以再添一个定语从句（我们可以用5w 法来引导思路）。
如果是对比性的图片内容，只需要用By contrast（相比之下）另起一句就可以了~
It can be seen that, two tourists sit and eat snacks in a boat, casually throwing their
rubbish into the lake which is full of pollutants.
如图，两个游客坐在船上一边吃零食，一边随手把垃圾丢进满目垃圾的湖水里。
It can be seen that, a man stands still in depression, sighing for the loss when he saw
a fallen bottle with water leaking away.
7
图中有个人呆呆地站在那儿，看着倾倒漏水的瓶子，哀叹损失，一脸沮丧。
It can be seen that, an army of graduate students stand at the juncture of several
choices, confusing which path is best for their future.
如图，毕业大军处在多个选择的岔路口，困惑于何去何从。
It can be seen that, a mother was still in the prime of her life thirty years ago, holding
the tiny hand of her lovely daughter who was apparently an elementary student. By
contrast, now the mother is aged with energy draining away, but her little girl has
grown up and become the one holding her mother into her arm.
如图，三十年前，一位母亲还年华正好，握着她宝贝女儿的小手，而她的女儿显然还是个小
学生。相比之下，这位母亲如今年华消逝，已显老迈，但她的小女儿已经长大成人，成了母
亲可以依靠的人。
It can be seen that, a group of friends gather around a table in a party, all staring at
their mobile phones as if they are isolated from each other.
如图，一群朋友围桌聚餐，却各自盯着自己的手机，仿佛彼此孤立一般。
8
It can be seen that, a father sits in front of a television, ordering his son to study hard
when he himself is watching dramas. By contrast, the father on the right-hand side of
the picture is writing attentively when his son is doing homework.
如图，一位父亲坐在电视机前，命令他的儿子好好学习，而他自己却在看剧。相比之下，图
片右侧的父亲在儿子做作业时，也在聚精会神地写着东西。
It can be seen that, a man leisurely sits in a chair, saying with satisfaction that he owns
a lot of books, although without reading them at all. By contrast, the boy on the right-
hand side of the picture is making an actual plan of reading 20 books before the end
of the year.
如图，一个男人悠哉地坐在椅子上，心满意足地说，他有很多书，但他根本就没有读过。与
之形成对比的是，图片右侧的男孩正在制定切实的读书计划，要在年内读完20 本书。
It can be seen that, a student sits in front of a computer, wondering if he should select
the courses featured by high score, easy exam and less homework, or choose those
conveying innovative and frontier knowledge but difficult to learn.
如图，一个学生坐在电脑前，不知道应该选择分数高、易通过、作业少的课程，还是选择那
些知识新、重创新、有难度的课程。
9
It can be seen that, a man wants to give up in the way of climbing a mountain, saying
that he is exhausted. By contrast, the other man is full of passion in face of difficulties
and encourages his partner to brace up and go on after a rest.
如图，一个人在爬山途中想要放弃，说自己已经筋疲力尽。相比之下，另一个人则不畏艰难，
激情满满，鼓励他的同伴打起精神，休息一下再接着爬。
It can be seen that, a girl is doing her homework, feeling that things should be done
as early as possible. By contrast, the boy on the right-hand side of the picture sits in
front of the desk, saying that he will put things off until the last minute.
如图，一个女孩儿正在做作业，觉得事情应该尽早完成。相比之下，图片右侧的男孩儿则坐
在书桌前，说不到最后不动手。
It can be seen that, a father stands in front of his son, encouraging him to get rid of
concern about studying Chinese drama if it is what he truly likes.
如图，一位父亲鼓励儿子，只要真心喜欢，就去学习中国戏剧，不要在乎别人的看法。
结合上期讲的四个句型，我们就可以应对考研作文的开头段了！

【图画作文】中间段怎么写 | 社会现象题型
社会现象题型模板
模板说明
1. Behind such phenomenon lies a perception that：挖掘现象背后的问题
2. Much of this can be blamed on...：通过拟人修辞来揭示原因
3. Admittedly, …has put us on the trajectory of…while bringing…：从正面阐释现象
4. However, on the flip side, …is felt in…：从反面论说现象
5. And it is (actually) exemplified by the case illustrated in the above picture：凑字数
专用
6. For this reason, we should recalibrate our way of...since…is subject to...：（总结句）
鉴于此，我们应该重新调整…的行为，因为…会受到…的影响
下面我们通过历年真题进行实操~
11
首先揭示问题，并指出问题原因：
Behind such phenomenon lies a perception that, people’s misbehaviors have
weighed on our beautiful landscape, and much of this can be blamed on our lack of
environmental awareness.
然而，从另一方面来看，我们在生活中随处可以感受到人为因素造成的破坏，图片中的事例
就说明了这一点。
然后正说现象：
Admittedly, modernization, urbanization and industrialization have put us on the
trajectory of rapid development while bringing us great convenience.
诚然，现代化、城市化和工业化进程使我们走上了快速发展的轨道，同时给我们带来了极大
的便利。
再反说现象：
However, on the flip side, man-made damage is felt everywhere in day-to-day life,
and it is actually exemplified by the case illustrated in the above picture.
这种现象揭示出，人们的不当行为给我们的美丽家园造成了沉重的负担，而这在很大程度上
归咎于人们缺乏环保意识。
最后提方案、做总结：
For this reason, we should recalibrate our way of interacting with the environment
12
since sustainable development is subject to the harmonious coexistence between man
and nature.
鉴于此，我们应该重新调整人类与环境的互动方式，因为可持续发展取决于人与自然的和谐
共存。
先揭示现象背后的问题和造成问题的原因：
Behind such phenomenon lies a perception that, digital devices have disrupted our
traditional way of interactions, and much of this can be blamed on our indulgence in
the virtual world.
这种现象揭示出，数字设备已经干扰了人们传统的交流方式，这在很大程度上归咎于，我们
过于沉溺于虚拟世界当中。
接下来，从正反两方面阐述现象：
Admittedly, modern communication tools have put us on the trajectory of instant
connections while bringing us great convenience. However, on the flip side, increasing
isolation is felt in our day-to-day life, and it is actually exemplified by the case
illustrated in the above picture.
无可否认，现代通讯工具使我们实现了即联即通，给我们带来了极大的便利。然而，从另一
方面来看，人与人之间却越发疏离，图片中的事例就说明了这一点。
最后用一句话进行总结：
13
For this reason, we should recalibrate our way of communication since harmonious
relationship is subject to real interpersonal interactions.
鉴于此，我们应该重新调整彼此的沟通方式，因为和谐的关系取决于真正的人际互动。
【图画作文】中间段怎么写 | 寓意哲理题型
寓意哲理题型模板
1. 挖掘图片背后的深意：
Behind this instructive drawing lies a perception that：
注：这里的instructive drawing 还可以根据图片内容换成更具象的词语
2. 点出寓意主旨：
14
…is an ingredient of..., and it lights the way to…
…是…的要素，并点亮了通往…的道路
3. 从反面论说一般人的做法：
However, more than often, we are mired in…, killing one’s chances / slamming the
door of...
人们却经常陷入……，从而失去了……的机会
4. 指出反面情况的后果：
This lack of…is what often leads us to…, and acts as a drag on…
正是因为缺乏…，导致我们…，并构成了…的阻碍
5. 从正面进行论说：
Actually, …is measured by…, and…is the very condition to…
其实，…是由…来衡量的，而…才是…的条件
6. 最后指出应该怎样做：
So, do sth. This is a recipe for…, and will yield fruitful results.
注：Do sth 是根据图片内容变化的祈使句；Fruitful results 也可以换成具体的结果
15
首先引出主旨：
Behind this instructive drawing lies a perception that, optimism is an essential
ingredient of happiness, and it lights the way to helpful actions.
这幅具有启发性的图画揭示出，乐观是幸福感的基本要素，可以引导我们采取有益的行动。
然后反面论说：
However, more than often, people tend to be mired in pessimism when there is a loss,
slamming the door of optimism about what they have been left.
然而，更多时候，人们会因为失去而陷入悲观，却没有乐观地看到自己还有些什么。
接下来是这种反面情绪的后果：
This lack of positive attitude is what often leads us to a dark mood, and acts as a drag
on our practice of moving ahead.
这种积极态度的缺失往往使我们陷入负面情绪，阻碍了我们前进的脚步。
然后话锋一转，正面论说道理：
Actually, happiness is measured by our own feeling of satisfaction, and a positive
mindset is the very condition to impel man to unfold his power.
其实，幸福是由我们自身的满足感来衡量的，而积极的心态正是推动人们施展能力的条件。
最后是号召大家采取的正面行动：
16
So, see the bright side when facing a setback. This is a recipe for a satisfying life, and
will yield fruitful results.
因此，面对挫折时要看到光明的一面，这是美好生活的秘诀，并将使你硕果累累。
首先是寓意主旨句：
Behind the father’s instructive words lies a perception that, interest is an essential
ingredient of motivated studies, and it lights the way to real devotion.
父亲的教诲揭示出一个道理，兴趣是产生学习动力的基本要素，可以使人真正地投入进去。
然后是反面论说：
However, more than often, we are mired in others’ judgement, killing our chances
of choosing what we truly like.
然而，更多时候，我们会被别人的评判所羁绊，放弃了自己真正喜欢的东西。
接下来是反面后果：
This lack of independence is what often leads us to a puppet life, and acts as a drag
on our pursuit of the things we dream about.
这种自主性的缺乏使我们成为了提线木偶，阻碍了我们追求自己的梦想。
然后转折，正面论说道理：
Actually, the value of life is measured by our own feeling of satisfaction, and interest
17
is the very condition to impel man to unfold his power.
其实，人生是由我们自身的满足感来衡量的，而兴趣正是推动人们施展能力的条件。
最后是正面行动：
So, follow your heart when making a decision. This is a recipe for a satisfying life, and
因此，在做决定时要追随我心，这是美好生活的秘诀，并将使你的人生硕果累累。
【图画作文】中间段怎么写 | 行为行事题型
行为行事题型模板
1. 挖掘主旨：
18
Behind this instructive drawing lies a perception that
2. 反面论说错误做法：
Admittedly, there is a convenient excuse for…
（我们）很容易找到（做某事）的借口
言下之意就是，这些借口都不应该成为借口
3. 对错误做法进行归因：
and it all boils down to a lack of…
注：Boil down 就是用煮沸、浓缩的意象来表达“归根结底”或“归结于”的意思
4. 转而从正面论说：
However, …is the (very) condition to...
然而，…才是促成...的条件
5. 平行论述：
Likewise, the ripple effect of…allows us to tap into…and sow a sense of…
同样，…的涟漪效应使我们能够…并产生…感
6. 说理总结：
All this gives enough grounds for doing…
鉴于此，我们有理由…
19
7. 最后指出我们应该怎样做：
So, do sth. It promises to (put you on the road to)…
所以，只要…做，我们就可以（通往）…
注：Promise to 的主语是Sth，而不是Sb 的时候，表示可以…的意思
接下来是真题实操~
首先点题：
Behind this instructive drawing lies a perception that, our satisfaction of “having
books” will eat into our motive of “reading books”.
这幅具有启发性的图画表明，我们对“有书”的满足感会削减我们“读书”的积极性。
然后是错误做法的借口和归因：
Admittedly, there is a convenient excuse for delaying our reading, and it all boils down
to a lack of motivated intention.
诚然，（我们）很容易找到借口，把阅读行动一拖再拖，这都是因为我们缺乏主动性。
接着转而正面论证：
However, tangible action is the very condition to impel man to unfold his power.
20
然而，切实的行动是促使人们施展能力的条件。
再同步横向论证：
Likewise, the ripple effect of massive reading allows us to tap into our potential and
sow a sense of confidence.
同样，大量阅读的涟漪效应能够使我们挖掘自身潜力，并获得自信心。
然后是说理总结：
All this gives enough grounds for reading books instead of having books only.
鉴于此，我们应该去阅读书籍，而不只是满足于拥有书籍。
最后是行动建议：
So, make a plan of reading right away. It promises to put you on the road to a treasure
of knowledge.
立即制定你的读书计划吧，这将助你通向知识的宝库。
首先是主旨句：
Behind this instructive drawing lies a perception that, never put off till tomorrow what
may be done today.
这幅富有启发性的图画点出了“今日事今日毕”的道理。
21
然后反面论证：
Admittedly, there is a convenient excuse for delaying our work until the last minute,
and it all boils down to a lack of a good habit in time management.
的确，（我们）很容易找到借口，把工作拖到最后一刻，这皆因我们缺乏时间管理的良好习惯。
接下来话锋一转，正面论证：
However, initiative spirit is the very condition to impel man to unfold his power.
Likewise, the ripple effect of motivated actions allows us to tap into our potential and
sow a sense of satisfaction.
然而，主动性是推动人们施展能力的条件。同样，积极行动的涟漪效应能够使我们挖掘自身
潜力，并获得满足感。
最后是说理总结和行动建议：
All this gives enough grounds for avoiding being a laggard. So, get hands on your
task. It promises to put you on the road to fruitful results.
鉴于此，我们应该拒绝拖沓。立即着手你的工作吧，这将助你收获累累硕果。
【图画作文】结尾段怎么写？
结尾段模板
22
1. 承上启下：
In a nutshell / Therefore
总而言之/因此
2. 总结中心要义：
At the center of this issue is the need to…
问题的核心是，（我们）需要……
3. 应该采取什么样的行动：
Only by translating…into…, can we…
只有将……转化成……才能……
4. 最后是强调句：
This is the right approach (for us) to…, and it will put sb in a better position to…
23
这是……的正确途径，可以使我们更好地……
注：有小伙伴反馈approach to 后面应该接doing，我查阅了《经济学人》往期期刊、
Linguee 上面的双语材料，以及亚马逊上的原版书名，to do 和to doing 的表达均有出现。
如果大家如果对approach to 的用法有顾虑，可以把approach 换成way/channel~
Therefore, at the center of this issue is the need to reduce pollution from all sources.
This is the right approach for us to protect our environmental future, and it will put
everyone in a better position to embrace our nature.
因此，问题的核心是要减少各个源头的污染。这是保护环境的正确途径，并使我们更好地拥
抱自然。
In a nutshell, only by translating our attitude into a positive one, can we redirect our
mind instead of focusing on the negative experiences. This is the right approach for
us to keep a positive outlook in work and life.
总之,只有转化为积极的态度，我们才能调整思维，而不是纠结于那些消极的经历。这是我们
在工作和生活中保持积极心态的正确方法。
In a nutshell, at the center of this issue is the need to shift our focus from a virtual
24
world to the tangible reality. This is the right approach to engage with each other, and
it will put us in a better position to get closer.
通的正确途径，可以使人与人之间更加亲近。
Therefore, only by taking the initiative to read, can we really benefit from books. This
is the right approach to acquire knowledge, and it will put us in a better position to
prepare for a more fruitful future.
因此，只有主动阅读，才能真正从书本中受益。这是获取知识的正确方法，可以使我们在未
来收获更多。
In a nutshell, at the center of this issue is the need to foster a good habit of seizing
the time. This is the right approach to become more efficient, and it will put us in a
better position to lift our performance.
简言之，问题的核心是需要培养利用时间的好习惯。这是高效做事的正确方法，可以使我们
有更好的表现。
Therefore, don’t surrender to general opinions. Only by translating “what we truly
like” into “what we actually do”, can we find the right approach to shape the yet-
25
to-be-made future with more delicious experiences.
因此，不要屈从于大众看法。只有把“真正喜欢的东西”转化为“切实去做的事情”，我们
才能在美好的体验中去塑造未来。
【材料分析作文】模板+范文
23 年考研英语大纲样题——材料分析题
阅读下面的文章选段，说一说你是否同意或在何种程度上同意作者的观点
Many of us, whatever our field of work, fear that showing uncertainty can damage our
image —— and we may compensate by expressing overconfidence in an attempt to
win trust. But in many situations people are willing to trust those who can admit they
don ’t have a definite answer. Recent studies found that communicating uncertainty
and even admitting our mistakes is not harmful and can even be beneficial to
trustworthiness. So, failure in “expertise” can be compensated by higher integrity
and benevolence. When communicating uncertainty in a transparent way, we are
perceived as less biased and wiling to tell the truth.
文章大意：很多人担心，在工作中表现出不确定性会有损自己的形象，所以他们会表现得过
度自信，以便赢得他人的信任。但人们往往更愿意相信那些能够承认自己并不确定或承认犯
错的人。当我们坦诚地表现出不确定性时，别人会认为我们没有偏颇，愿意说实话。
开头段模板
26
1. 首先要对作者的观点进行概括：The author argues that...
2. 挖掘主旨: Behind these instructive words lies a perception that
3. 表明观点: I strongly agree / strongly disagree / can only partially agree with such
perspective when it comes to...
样题实操
The author argues that showing uncertainty, instead of expressing overconfidence, is
a better way to gain trust. Behind these instructive words lies a perception that, never
pretend to know when you don’t know, and I strongly agree with such perspective
when it comes to how to get effective communication.
作者认为，表现出不确定性，而不是过度自信，是获得信任的更好方式。在这些富有启发性
的话语背后，含有这样一种认知：永远不要不懂装懂。我非常认同这个观点，这关乎有效的
沟通。
中间段模板
27
1. 首先从反面入手： Admittedly, there is a convenient excuse for
2. 对错误做法进行归因： and it all boils down to a lack of…
3. 转而从正面论说：
4. 平行论述： Likewise, the ripple effect of…allows us to tap into…and sow a sense of…
5. 说理总结： All this gives enough grounds to do / for sth
Admittedly, people tend to show certainty out of vanity when they actually don’t
have a definite answer, and it all boils down to a lack of real confidence. However,
being frank is the very condition to stand as a trustworthy man, while uncertainty does
not equal to ignorance. Likewise, the ripple effect of showing uncertainty allows us to
tap into candid exchanges and sow a sense of mutual trust. All this gives enough
grounds to communicate uncertainty in a transparent way instead of being the slave
of false confidence.
28
诚然，出于虚荣，人们往往会表现出笃定的态度，而实际上他们并没有确定的答案，这一切
都归结为缺乏真正的自信。然而，坦诚以待是一个人值得信赖的根本，而对某事的不确定也
并不等于人的无知。同样，展示不确定性，更有利于我们坦诚交流，并播下互信的种子。鉴
于此，我们应该坦诚沟通，展示不确定性，而不是被虚荣所奴役。
1. 承上启下，总结要义： In a nutshell / Therefore, ...
2. 再次强调： This is the right approach to…, and it will put sb in a better position to…
In a nutshell, be frank with your doubt and uncertainty. This is the right approach to
show real expertise, and it will put us in a better position to win trust with higher
integrity.
一言以蔽之，坦诚地表达你的疑虑和不确定性。这才是专业人士的正确作法。有了更好的诚
信，我们就能赢得更高的信任。
29
30
【图表作文】模板 | 图表描述
图表描述
1. 首先要把图表类型列出来
有bar chart / column chart / line graph / table 几种题型
2. 然后紧接一句allows us a holistic view of 来综述图表要义
……图表使我们看到了……的整体情况
3. 接着具体描述图表内容
…constitute(s) a massive (65%) / a mere (5%)
……占……之多 / 仅占……
明显具有主导性的数据可以用a massive+百分数来表示，10%以内非主导性数据可以用a
31
mere+百分数的表达形式，中间段的数据可以用followed by 引出
注：如果constitute 后面只接数据的话，这个百分数前面千万不要加a。
4. 如果最小的数据能够和前面的数字形成对照关系，就可以用In contrast 来引导；非对照关
系也可以加一个still 来进行过渡。
5. 有些图表比较复杂，含有数据的变化关系，这种情况我们只需要在列出数据后加一个
Upward / downward trend 来点出变化趋势即可
21 年题目
The column chart allows us a holistic view of different ways adopted by residents in a
certain city for doing physical exercises. To be specific, people opting for exercising
alone constitute a majority (54.30%), followed by those doing it with friends (47.70%).
In contrast, fewer people choose to exercise with their family (23.90%) or in groups
(15.80%).
该柱状图让我们对某市居民体育锻炼的几种方式有了全面的了解。具体来说，选择独自锻炼
的人占大多数（54.30%），其次是和朋友一起锻炼的人（47.70%）。相比之下，选择与家人
一起锻炼（23.90%）或团体活动的人数（15.80%）较少。
20 年题目
The pie chart allows us a holistic view of the purposes for reading on a cellphone
32
among college students in a certain university. To be specific, the students opting for
learning by it constitute a massive 59.5%, followed by those reading on a cellphone
for entertainment (21.3%) and those for getting information (17.0%). Still, there are
other purposes that constitute a mere 2.2%.
该饼状图让我们对某高校学生手机阅读目的有了一个整体认知。具体来说，选择通过手机学
习的学生占59.5%，其次是通过手机消磨时间（21.3%）和获取信息（17.0%）。此外，其他
目的只占2.2%。
19 年题目
The column chart allows us a holistic view of the choices after graduation in a certain
college in 2013 and 2018. To be specific, the graduates choosing to work constitute a
massive 68.1% in 2013 and 60.7% in 2018, followed by those going for further study
(26.3% in 2013 and 34.0% in 2018) and those for starting a business (1.3% in 2013 and
2.6% in 2018). Overall, there is an upward trend in the choices of pursuing further
study and starting a business, but a downward trend in choosing to work.
该柱状图让我们对某高校2013年和2018年的毕业选择情况有了整体了解。具体来说，2013
年和2018 年选择就业的毕业生分别占了68.1%和60.7%，其次是选择继续深造的毕业生
（2013 年为26.3%，2018 年为34.0%）和创业的毕业生（2013 年为1.3%，2018 年为
2.6%）。总体来说，选择升学和创业的人数有上升的趋势，而选择就业的人数则有所下降。
33
【图表作文】模板 | 原因分析
该模板适用于考研英语（二）大作文的原因分析段落（第二段）
原因分析模板
1. 首先是一个承上启下的过渡句
Such information brings clarity to…, and it can be further interpreted as follows:
该信息清楚地说明了……，并可进一步解释如下：
2. 然后具体解释数据上升的原因
…is an impetus for…
……的推动力是……
3. 数据下降的原因
34
The shrinking number of…is the result of…
数量的减少是由于……
注：如果没有动态的升降，只是解释一个静态的数据，那么可以把shrinking number 换成
dominant number（数量多）或weak number（数量少）
4. 我们也可以先写一个原因句，然后另起一句
This led to a rise in the total number of…
这导致了…总数的上升
注：这里的rise 也可以换成drop
5. 引出原因的几个万用备胎
This means / This explains / It justifies / It supports…  / …makes it clear that...
这意味着 / 说明了 / 证明…合乎情理 /支持了… /…清楚地表明…
注：其中Justify 是Justice 的动词形式，表示……合乎情理
19 年考研真题：毕业生去向统计
Such information brings clarity to the pattern of graduates’ choices, and it can be
further interpreted as follows: Firstly, the shrinking number of graduates choosing to
work is the result of sluggish job market. Secondly, the competitive environment is an
35
impetus for the rising number of those advancing their studies. Thirdly, opportunities
abound in the world today, and this led to a rise in the total number of college startups,
but this group is still way outnumbered by the former two since very few people are
prepared to face a volatile future.
该信息清楚地说明了毕业生的选择概况，并可进一步解释如下：首先，选择工作的毕业生人
数减少，这是就业市场不景气的结果。其次，竞争环境激烈，这是推动升学人数上升的动力。
第三，当今世界，机会比比皆是，这使大学生创业的总体人数有所上升，但这一群体仍然远
远不及前两个群体的人数，因为很少有人做好准备，去面对一个不太稳定的未来。
21 年考研真题：体育锻炼方式
Such information brings clarity to the pattern of people’s exercising preferences, and
it can be further interpreted as follows: Firstly, most people enjoy the freedom of
exercising alone, because this means a changeable schedule and mind relaxation.
Secondly, the longing for communication is rooted in the hearts of all men, and it
justifies people’s choice of doing exercise with their friends, but fewer people would
choose a family member since they have spent too much time together. Thirdly, group
activities are not conveniently available anywhere and anytime. This led to a weak
number of people exercising in groups.
该信息清楚地说明了人们的锻炼偏好，并可进一步解释如下：首先，大多数人喜欢独自锻炼
带来的自由感，因为这意味着时间自如、心灵放松。其次，人们都有交流的愿望，所以愿意
选择和朋友一起锻炼，但选择和家人一起锻炼的人数比较少，因为他们平时在一起的时间已
经很长了。第三，团体活动不是随时随地就可以参加的，致使选择团体锻炼的人数很少。
36
【图表作文】模板 | 总结收尾
1. In the final analysis
归根结底，总之
2. The number of… is expected to keep growing
……的数量预计会持续增长
注：grow 可以替换成drop 或shrink 等词汇
3. …will remain the focus of…
……依然是……的焦点
37
该句可变形为：…will remain the dominant choice of… 或 …will remain to make up the
majority of
4. And it offers us a (promising) vision of…
这给了我们一种（充满希望的）愿景
5. And it is advisable to…
建议……
17 年真题
In the final analysis, the number of museums and visitors is expected to keep growing
in the near future, and it offers us a promising vision of a more civilized society.
总之，博物馆和参观者的数量预计近些年将持续增长，我们的社会有望变得更加文明。
18 年真题
In the final analysis, the characteristics of a restaurant will remain the focus of
consumers in the near future, and it is advisable to make featured delicacies if a
restaurant is going to earn its reputation.
19 年真题
38
In the final analysis, the number of graduates going for entrepreneurship is expected
to keep growing in the near years, and it offers us a promising vision of a more
dynamic market.
总之，毕业生创业的人数在近些年还会持续增长，这让我们有望看到一个更具活力的市场。
20 年真题
In the final analysis, learning will remain the focus of college students for mobile
reading in the near future, and it offers us a promising vision of a more knowledge-
based society.
总之，近些年，学习仍将是高校学生手机阅读的重点，这让我们有望看到一个更加知识型的
社会。
21 年真题
In the final analysis, there will remain diversified ways for physical exercises in the near
years, and it offers us a promising vision of a fitness-for-all society.
总之，在近些年，体育锻炼的方式仍将呈现多样化的特点，我们有望看到一个全民健身的社
会。
